body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Folks,
Elon Musk’s DOGE took millions of Americans’ private Social Security records and handed access to election deniers . Congress needs to make sure it never happens again.
The Department of Justice has now admitted that the Department of Government Efficiency gained sweeping access to addresses, birthdates, and identifiers that can be weaponized to target voters, suppress turnout, or erode trust in elections. DOGE’s access came as Trump and his allies escalated attacks on mail-in voting and independent federal agencies.
That context matters. This was a power grab designed to undermine our democracy using our private data. Congress must not ignore this or look away.
Tell Congress to investigate DOGE’s efforts to access and share our private Social Security data with election deniers. Demand that all who participated in the scheme are held accountable, and make sure this never happens again >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/tell-congress-investigate-doges-attempt-to-undermine-our-elections/?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]
START WRITING NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/tell-congress-investigate-doges-attempt-to-undermine-our-elections/?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]
DOGE was created by executive order, shielded from transparency, and staffed with political loyalists. Reports show its operatives bypassed standard clearance procedures and ignored internal warnings to gain and share “unprecedented” access to our data with no guardrails.
DOGE staffers engaged in prohibited political activity while embedded inside a nonpartisan agency in violation of the Hatch Act. This is how elections are undermined from inside the government.
Congress must act now — not only to expose what happened, but to ensure it can never happen again . The House Oversight Committee and the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee must launch a full investigation, subpoena DOGE leadership, and lock in safeguards so no future administration can abuse federal data to rig the system.
Send your letter today to demand Congress investigate DOGE, defend our data privacy, and make sure this never happens again >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/tell-congress-investigate-doges-attempt-to-undermine-our-elections/?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

And yes, to be honest, this is one of them (sorry!). We need all the help we can get to fight back against the $300,000 Mike Johnson just dropped into this race, so if you’re able, I’d be incredibly grateful if **_[you could chip in a few bucks.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125036008/600482918/819412648?amounts=5,10,15,25,50,100,250,500&refcode=email_020926_mydecision&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTIzMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDY0MmY0Ny1kMTA1LWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDBkM2ExODk0MmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XnnZWcZteKgunMee-ToAY3fvjAL7zhQFVtIOCVU-5Fc=)_** **But, if you have a minute, I also wanted to explain not just why I’m asking for your support, but why I decided to run for Congress in the first place.** I was born and raised here in Michigan, a public school kid from modest roots. Now I’m proud to be raising my own kids here in Kalamazoo, and I’ve spent most of my life serving this community, first as a City Commissioner, then as a state representative, and now as a state senator. To me, leadership is all about solving problems and making life better for the people you serve, which is what I’ve worked to do every day as a public servant — whether it was cracking down on slumlords, leading disaster relief with the Red Cross, or delivering tax relief to Michigan’s seniors and working families. **Fundamentally, being a good leader means living your values. And the reason I’m running for Congress is that Washington has never seemed more out of touch with the values I’ve spent my life fighting for than it does right now.** Right before I entered this race, my opponent Bill Huizenga _was one of two deciding votes_ to throw 450,000 Michigan residents off their health coverage. And boy did that cement my decision to run against him! **But even since that absolutely disgraceful and disqualifying vote, Huizenga has continued attacking the Michigan families he’s supposed to be serving.** He voted to gut the Affordable Care Act — raising health care premiums all across our country this year. You’re probably paying higher bills because of this and so is almost everyone you know. He’s stood against accountability for ICE and refused to exercise any of Congress’s oversight powers to hold Donald Trump or his administration to account. And when some of Huizenga’s constituents visited his office to try to peacefully share their concerns? Huizenga’s office _wouldn’t even unlock the door._ **Put simply, the people of Michigan deserve better leadership. And I’m determined to give it to them. So yes, I’m running to end Bill Huizenga’s political career. Proudly.** But to get this done — and not just “come close” or score some worthless moral victory — I need your help. Unlike so many other candidates, I’m not some self-funding billionaire and I’m not backed by big special interests — so the success of our campaign depends on supporters like you. **_[So if you’re with me in this fight, and if you support my decision to take on MAGA mouthpiece Bill Huizenga, can I count on you to pitch in today and power our fight?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125036009/600482919/819412648?amounts=5,10,15,25,50,100,250,500&refcode=email_020926_mydecision&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTIzMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDY0MmY0Ny1kMTA1LWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDBkM2ExODk0MmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XnnZWcZteKgunMee-ToAY3fvjAL7zhQFVtIOCVU-5Fc=)_** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | | [Donate $5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125036010/600482920/819412648?express_lane=true&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&amount=5&refcode=email_020926_mydecision&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTIzMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDY0MmY0Ny1kMTA1LWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDBkM2ExODk0MmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XnnZWcZteKgunMee-ToAY3fvjAL7zhQFVtIOCVU-5Fc=)

|

|

Hi friends, Early voting for the Democratic primary starts next **Tuesday, February 17** and ends**Friday February 27th.** This race is going to be close. In a contested primary, turnout matters more than anything. A few hundred votes can decide who moves forward, which is why I’m asking you to make a plan now. Here’s what you can do today:
* Check your voter registration
* Find your early voting location and hours
* Talk to friends and family about voting early

Voting early helps avoid long lines, work conflicts, and last-minute surprises. I’m running because East Texas deserves a representative who will fight for working families, protect our freedoms, and bring honesty back to Congress. But I can’t do this without you. If you’re ready to help:
* Volunteer or Donate
* Share our campaign on social media
* Make sure you and your people vote early

Every vote counts.
**Here's where to find us this week**
We’d love to see you out in the community. Here’s where you can find our campaign this week:

We’ll be there to listen and connect.

South Central Church of Christ

Sunday, February 15 - 1pm
Block walking in Tyler
With the Smith County Young Democrats

Ruby’s on Vine, Tyler
Thank you for being part of this movement.

On October 7th, 2025, one of the biggest free speech cases was heard at the U.S. Supreme Court!

Kaley Chiles stood alongside her ADF attorneys to challenge a Colorado law that censors her speech in counseling conversations. It forbids licensed counselors like Kaley from having conversations that could help clients regain comfort with their sex--_even if that 's the client's goal._

It's a clear violation of the First Amendment. But this case also points to a much deeper, spiritual battle.

Laws like this one allow lies to spread--lies like one's sex can be changed and God makes mistakes with His creation. These laws suppress truth from going forward by forbidding people like Kaley from speaking it in counseling.

Kaley is stepping up to challenge this law. And a win in her case could help roll back similar laws in 22 other states.

**I want you to think about that for a moment. One young woman 's courageous stand could reach countless lives with the truth.**

I've had the privilege of getting to know Kaley over the last few months, and I have been so encouraged by her unwavering hope in the Lord and commitment to the truth.

It's not been an easy road. The law threatens exorbitant fines and even loss of her license if she follows the truth in the counseling room and helps young clients pursue alignment of their identity with their body. She's also facing tremendous backlash for choosing to push back on this law--and more is sure to come.

Our enemy, the father of lies, will work to oppose the truth and those who speak it at every turn.

But your prayers can make a difference. Will you please pray...
* **For Kaley** --that God would strengthen and encourage her, and that she would sense His peace in the months to come as we await the Court's decision

* **For our culture** --that God would use this case to open more eyes to the harms of gender ideology, and that hearts would turn toward the truth of knowing Him

**By Eric Lullove, DPM**
I am a podiatrist. My professional life is spent in the weeds of wound care and limb salvage--preventing the "slow-motion" tragedies of chronic disease. I don't run a vaccine clinic, and I'm not a career immunologist. But I am a physician who understands how a system breaks.
In my previous articles on the ACA and the crumbling foundations of our healthcare delivery, I've argued that medicine is only as strong as its infrastructure. Right now, our public health infrastructure is experiencing a massive security breach. The recent spike of measles in the U.S. isn't just a medical anomaly; it is a direct consequence of a leadership philosophy that has traded rote science for political theater.
#### **The Data: A System in Red-Alert**
We are currently witnessing the most aggressive resurgence of measles in modern American history. The numbers aren't just "concerning"--they are an indictment of our current health security posture:
* **The 2025/2026 Surge:** In the last 14 months, we have surpassed **2,500 confirmed cases**. To put that in perspective, we declared measles "eliminated" in this country in 2000. We are now moving backward at terminal velocity.
* **The Herd Immunity Floor:** Epidemiology tells us that to stop a measles outbreak, we need a **95% vaccination rate**. We have officially dipped below **92%** in several key states.
* **The Contagion Factor:** Measles has an (basic reproduction number) of **12 to 18**. This is not a "flu-like" spread; this is a biological wildfire. One infected child in a classroom can effectively shut down an entire school district's health safety within a week.

* * *
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_._daJHErdgqev7gGUZbo3wt4mJP1ZVHS7S73YfoWqqtg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=187398014)
* * *
#### **A Failure of Federal Guardianship**
The Trump administration's approach to healthcare security has been characterized by a dangerous "deconstruction" of the administrative state. By framing routine immunizations as a matter of "individual preference" rather than a pillar of national security, they have invited the virus back into our homes.
When federal agencies like the CDC are pressured to "narrow" vaccine recommendations or when the administration questions the validity of the ACIP's rote science, they aren't championing freedom--they are creating a vacuum. History and science tell us that viruses do not respect "freedom of choice." They only respect the barrier of a vaccinated population.
The administration is failing America's healthcare security by:
1. **Sowing Institutional Distrust:** Replacing rigorous clinical data with "alternative" medical perspectives.
2. **Budgetary Atrophy:** Defunding the surveillance programs that catch these outbreaks before they cross state lines.
3. **Policy Regression:** Encouraging the expansion of non-medical exemptions that leave our most vulnerable--infants and the immunocompromised--exposed.

#### **The Prognosis: The High Cost of "Freedom"**
The damage is not just clinical; it is fiscal. A single measles outbreak in a county can cost taxpayers millions in emergency response, lost workdays, and hospitalizations. When the "pro-business" party ignores the economic devastation of a preventable epidemic, the hypocrisy is as clear as the clinical symptoms.
##### **The fix is not complicated, but it requires courage:**
* **Decouple Science from Politics:** We must return the CDC to an independent, science-first footing where data, not polling, dictates the vaccine schedule.
* **National Security Standards:** We should view vaccination rates as a metric of national readiness. A state with a 90% vaccination rate is a hole in our national defense.
* **Mandatory Transparency:** We need a federal crackdown on misinformation that masquerades as "medical advice" in the public square.

As a doctor, I see the result of "waiting too long" every day in my wound care practice. You don't wait for the infection to reach the bone before you act. America's public health is currently "septic," and until we return to the rote science of vaccine medicine, the prognosis for our healthcare security remains guarded.

As your constituent, I am writing to demand immediate legislative action to address the catastrophic 2026 measles resurgence. Our national healthcare security is failing, and the current administration's retreat from rote science is to blame.
The facts are clear:
* **The Crisis:** We have seen over **580 cases** in January 2026 alone, following a record-breaking 2,200 cases in 2025.
* **The Vulnerability:** National vaccination rates have dropped to **92.5%** , well below the 95% threshold required for herd immunity.

We cannot allow "medical freedom" rhetoric to dismantle decades of public health security. I urge you to support the independence of the CDC, restore the integrity of the childhood immunization schedule, and fund emergency containment efforts in high-outbreak states.

A Doctor Explains Why Measles Is Spreading Again in America | | and | Feb 9 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Blue Amp Media is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support our work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. By Eric Lullove, DPM I am a podiatrist. My professional life is spent in the weeds of wound care and limb salvage--preventing the "slow-motion" tragedies of chronic disease. I don't run a vaccine clinic, and I'm not a career immunologist. But I am a physician who understands how a system breaks. In my previous articles on the ACA and the crumbling foundations of our healthcare delivery, I've argued that medicine is only as strong as its infrastructure. Right now, our public health infrastructure is experiencing a massive security breach. The recent spike of measles in the U.S. isn't just a medical anomaly; it is a direct consequence of a leadership philosophy that has traded rote science for political theater. The Data: A System in Red-Alert We are currently witnessing the most aggressive resurgence of measles in modern American history. The numbers aren't just "concerning"--they are an indictment of our current health security posture: The 2025/2026 Surge: In the last 14 months, we have surpassed 2,500 confirmed cases. To put that in perspective, we declared measles "eliminated" in this country in 2000. We are now moving backward at terminal velocity. The Herd Immunity Floor: Epidemiology tells us that to stop a measles outbreak, we need a 95% vaccination rate. We have officially dipped below 92% in several key states. The Contagion Factor: Measles has an (basic reproduction number) of 12 to 18. This is not a "flu-like" spread; this is a biological wildfire. One infected child in a classroom can effectively shut down an entire school district's health safety within a week. A Failure of Federal Guardianship The Trump administration's approach to healthcare security has been characterized by a dangerous "deconstruction" of the administrative state. By framing routine immunizations as a matter of "individual preference" rather than a pillar of national security, they have invited the virus back into our homes. When federal agencies like the CDC are pressured to "narrow" vaccine recommendations or when the administration questions the validity of the ACIP's rote science, they aren't championing freedom--they are creating a vacuum. History and science tell us that viruses do not respect "freedom of choice." They only respect the barrier of a vaccinated population. The administration is failing America's healthcare security by: 1. Sowing Institutional Distrust: Replacing rigorous clinical data with "alternative" medical perspectives. 2. Budgetary Atrophy: Defunding the surveillance programs that catch these outbreaks before they cross state lines. 3. Policy Regression: Encouraging the expansion of non-medical exemptions that leave our most vulnerable--infants and the immunocompromised--exposed. The Prognosis: The High Cost of "Freedom" The damage is not just clinical; it is fiscal. A single measles outbreak in a county can cost taxpayers millions in emergency response, lost workdays, and hospitalizations. When the "pro-business" party ignores the economic devastation of a preventable epidemic, the hypocrisy is as clear as the clinical symptoms. The fix is not complicated, but it requires courage: Decouple Science from Politics: We must return the CDC to an independent, science-first footing where data, not polling, dictates the vaccine schedule. National Security Standards: We should view vaccination rates as a metric of national readiness. A state with a 90% vaccination rate is a hole in our national defense. Mandatory Transparency: We need a federal crackdown on misinformation that masquerades as "medical advice" in the public square. As a doctor, I see the result of "waiting too long" every day in my wound care practice. You don't wait for the infection to reach the bone before you act. America's public health is currently "septic," and until we return to the rote science of vaccine medicine, the prognosis for our healthcare security remains guarded. SEND THIS LETTER TO YOUR CONGRESSPERSON [Date] The Honorable [First Name] [Last Name] United States [Senate/House of Representatives] Washington, DC [Zip Code] RE: Emergency Response to the 2026 Measles Outbreak Dear [Senator/Representative] [Last Name] , As your constituent, I am writing to demand immediate legislative action to address the catastrophic 2026 measles resurgence. Our national healthcare security is failing, and the current administration's retreat from rote science is to blame. The facts are clear: The Crisis: We have seen over 580 cases in January 2026 alone, following a record-breaking 2,200 cases in 2025. The Vulnerability: National vaccination rates have dropped to 92.5% , well below the 95% threshold required for herd immunity. The Cost: Outbreaks are draining local budgets and filling pediatric ICUs with patients suffering from a entirely preventable disease. We cannot allow "medical freedom" rhetoric to dismantle decades of public health security. I urge you to support the independence of the CDC, restore the integrity of the childhood immunization schedule, and fund emergency containment efforts in high-outbreak states. Please prioritize the biological security of our children over political theater. I look forward to your response. Sincerely, [Your Name] [Your City, State] | | ---|---|--- | A guest post by| . subject: The message Charlie carried into eternity
body:
[unsubscribe](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xul=1nmc5a54x67zfmd5fi2bt1ih25b7b3fl9iap7qk93k20jbs43c8qnqs4jp4e4xa1vc0cemnutn66oquxozu9sh8olddd4v8y1syw2knacyaplo96v59o&__stmp=ta7ajb&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.

Steve Thompson, Editor
* * *

| | | [](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7ajb&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7ajb&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7ajb&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7ajb&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7ajb&__onlt=h)**

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

| | | | | |
Friends,
Under Governor Kemp’s leadership, Georgia has weathered COVID, civil unrest, and real economic hardship. Through it all, Georgia families have shown resilience and they deserve relief.
That’s why Brad strongly supports the Governor’s efforts to make Georgia more affordable by returning tax dollars directly to hardworking Georgians through immediate tax rebates.
Sadly, some lawmakers in Georgia think they know better. Instead of giving relief directly to taxpayers, they voted to send those dollars to local governments.
That doesn’t make sense. [And Brad said so immediately](https://us.list-manage.com/RAoN-fbTX5e?e=6036811227&c2id=73967910c0edbe1e25be629224bd5a72).
_“I don’t know what these lawmakers are thinking, but I hope they reconsider and do the right thing for the people they serve. Georgians need relief now. Adding another layer of bureaucracy is not how you make life more affordable for Georgia families.”_
Speaking of things that don’t make sense: efforts are still underway to force the Secretary of State’s office to release sensitive, private information like Social Security numbers, driver’s license numbers, and dates of birth to the Department of Justice and other unnamed third parties.
Even as he’s been attacked by members of the Senate, Brad remains unmoved._
“I thought they were supposed to be lawmakers, not lawbreakers.”_
No matter the pressure. No matter the politics. Brad Raffensperger stands for Georgia – no matter what.
\- Team Raff

---](https://us.list-manage.com/xYOKeimu8re?e=6036811227&c2id=73967910c0edbe1e25be629224bd5a72)
| | **Brad’s Blueprint to Make Georgia Safe**
Thanks to Joe Biden’s open-border policies and the radical left’s dangerous, anti-law enforcement agenda, Georgians are rightfully concerned about the safety and well-being of their loved ones. As a husband, father, and grandfather, Brad is unwavering in his commitment to protecting Georgia families, and has a clear, commonsense plan to make our state safe and prosperous.
**Double Down on School Safety**
* $100,000 Per Public School to Increase Security: Funding for more School Resource Officers, secure entrances, cameras, and emergency upgrades.

* Safety grants for private and charter schools: Ensure that every student is protected, regardless of where they attend school.

**Fully Fund and Staff Law Enforcement**
* Fully Fund State and Local Agencies.

* Recruitment and Retention Partnerships: Provide grants to state and local law enforcement for signing bonuses, training support, loan repayment, and housing assistance.

* Training and Technology Enhancements: Modern training and technology grants for equipment, digital tools, and dispatch upgrades.

Read more about Brad’s plan to make Georgia safe [**HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/l-6F6cbzmn2?e=6036811227&c2id=73967910c0edbe1e25be629224bd5a72).

---](https://us.list-manage.com/V5KekzkkOOj?e=6036811227&c2id=73967910c0edbe1e25be629224bd5a72)
| | | | | | | | | | | | **Albany Herald Opinion Editorial: 2026 is About Affordability and Public Safety**
In an op-ed published this week in The Albany Herald, Brad Raffensperger argues that Republicans must stay focused on voters’ top priorities heading into 2026, particularly affordability and public safety.
He outlines the economic pressures facing Georgia families, links public safety concerns to border failures and fentanyl, and calls for serious, conservative solutions rather than political distractions.
_“From Albany to Augusta, Gainesville to Rome, Georgians are working harder than ever but their paychecks aren’t stretching nearly as far. Many are picking up extra shifts, or even second jobs, and still struggling to keep up. That isn’t sustainable and we can do better.”_
_“I’ve proposed a comprehensive property tax relief plan that would cap property taxes for all Georgians and fully eliminate non-public safety, non-education property taxes for seniors.”_
_“Georgia parents are deeply concerned about the safety and focus of their local schools. They need assurance that classrooms are places for learning and growth, not soft targets for violence or platforms for political ideology.”_
---
|
---
| |
**AJC: As FBI rekindles 2020 fight, Raffensperger urges Georgians to look forward
** In light of the recent raid on Fulton County’s elections office, Brad urged lawmakers to focus on forward-looking national election reforms that strengthen security and transparency rather than re-litigating claims that have already been reviewed and rejected.
_“The path forward is through national reform, not repetition of old arguments that don’t add up. I urge lawmakers to focus on strengthening state administration of elections rather than rehashing the same outdated claims or worse — moving to federalize a core function of state government.”_

Read the entire article [**HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/_AK6rAzBo4B?e=6036811227&c2id=73967910c0edbe1e25be629224bd5a72).

| |
**AJC: Raffensperger ramps up First Liberty probe as lawmakers seek to curb powers**
Brad is intensifying his investigation into the First Liberty Building and Loan Ponzi scheme to ensure accountability and help Georgia families. Even as some lawmakers consider stalling the investigation, Brad emphasized his commitment to using every available tool to ensure swift justice.
_“We have been investigating this $140 million fraud in conjunction with federal authorities, and what we have uncovered so far is shocking. Victims of this scheme are hurting, and we are going to do whatever it takes to ensure accountability.”_

Read the entire article [**HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/w8jX7b_G_O1?e=6036811227&c2id=73967910c0edbe1e25be629224bd5a72).

This ruling is another win in our battle to protect the integrity of our elections,” said Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger, one of the defendants. “Rest assured, we will stand firm no matter what group tries to interfere.”_

Off to the Session!
| | | | | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KH1MVYMVG3X9TDZZG5DQPBCK_0)
---
| **Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, information and upcoming events.**
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Off to the Session!
---
| Hi friends, The 2026 legislative budget session has started, and my focus will be where it’s always been: showing up, doing the work, and trying to move Wyoming forward in a thoughtful, practical way. This includes running bills like the Stem Cell Freedom Act to give patients and doctors clear options with safeguards, and a roadside safety “Move Over” bill to help ensure the folks who stop on the side of the road get a wide berth by cars passing by. While I’m in Cheyenne focused on Senate duties, I’m deeply grateful to our campaign staff, county chairs, and statewide supporters like you who are carrying the load while I'm here - organizing, sharing, and keeping this campaign grounded in our Wyoming communities. As we look ahead to a big push after the session, we’ll need to build the resources it takes to reach people across the state—more signs, more materials, and the advertising budget needed to share a clear vision of getting back to the Wyoming we all love. I don’t ask lightly, but if you’re willing to help spread the word, host a gathering, or contribute where you can, I’d be grateful to have you riding alongside us. \- Eric
---
|
---
| | | Barlow Statement on Protecting Wyoming Beef Producers American farmers and ranchers raise the safest and highest quality beef in the world. Consumers know us as their neighbors, friends, and families, whose hard work delivers not only great protein, but also stewards of the animals, land, and water for future generations. Last week, the federal government quadrupled the amount of beef Argentina can send to the United States with no increased inspection protocols. The Administration got this one wrong. Increasing low-tariff beef imports from Argentina undermines American cattle producers, including many in Wyoming. Wyoming ranchers should be able to have a strong market to sell their beef free from misguided government intervention. I am confident Americans will choose domestic beef if they know where it comes from. Wyoming ranchers and farmers need to have the option to label their products as “Wyoming Beef”. I stand with Wyoming’s ranching and agricultural community.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | IN THE NEWS

[GILLETTE NEWS RECORD](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KH1MVYMVG3X9TDZZG5DQPBCK_1) “I’ve approached this campaign the same way I approach the legislature: Show up, listen, learn, then go do the work. Wyomingites want their communities to thrive, they want health care to be available, they want education to be valued, and they want the government to be limited, to know its place and stay there.”
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | YAY - SIGNS!! (Sourced in WY)

CAN YOU HELP WITH THE NEXT ORDER??
You've all been patient, and FINALLY, the Barlow for Governor signs are starting to appear across the Wyoming landscape, with strong backing for the Wyoming wind and weather! Many of you have asked for smaller yard signs, which will arrive for distribution this spring.
But, as you know...we have A LOT of land to cover. Can you help with an additional donation to keep the sign printer moving? Click the link below!
---
| | |
---
| | [ HELP WITH SIGN COSTS! ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KH1MVYMVG3X9TDZZG5DQPBCK_2)
---
| |
---
| Feb 9 Legislative Budget Session Convenes Feb 10: Wyoming Boys & Girls Club of Cheyenne Youth of the Year Speeches
8:00 – 10:00am, Capitol Rotunda Legislative Budget Session Feb 11 Senate Transportation 8:00 – 10:00am Legislative Budget Session Feb 12 Legislative Budget Session

Feb 13 Senate Transportation 8:00 – 10:00am Legislative Budget Session
---
| **On The Trail**
---
| |
---
| JOHNSON, SHERIDAN, CAMPBELL COUNTIES We had a wonderful few days in Northeast Wyoming this week! A special thank you to Cody and Sarah Jo Sinclair for organizing our Sheridan County events, and to Josh Law with OnlyCo for having me on his podcast! We started in Buffalo with a meet-and-greet at Bombshell’s, hosted by Barry and Kristen Crago, Ben and Laci Schiffer, and Bill Novotny. A great turnout of friends, old and new. And one Border Collie. Friday, we started the day early, visiting with folks at the Tongue River Valley Community Center in Dayton before going to the Innominate Coffeehouse in Ranchester for great conversation and a delicious breakfast.
Over lunch, we stopped by the HUB Senior Center in Sheridan for a chat before heading to the podcast. Spring-like temps meant our meet-and-greet at Sheridan's Blacktooth Brewing Company was full of sunshine and great conversation, followed by a fundraiser and delicious dinner at the Sinclairs.

"Jack Schlossberg is giving people something to believe in again and something to vote for. His candidacy will help democrats win nationwide — and it will help us flip the House."

"Jack understands that progress is not some abstract idea— it must be felt in daily life, in neighborhoods, and in hopes for the future. clean_body: I’m looking for supporters who can go the distance with us. Polls, momentum, and $3.5M raised doesn’t happen without grassroots supporters. I’m asking you to take the next step and become a monthly donor to help carry this fight all the way to victory. Peter, I'm sending this note to a special group of people. Hundreds of thousands follow me on social media. Millions of Californians will vote for me. But the person who ultimately keeps everything going is you , the grassroots supporter. I know that you carefully consider which campaigns to support. So your generosity humbles me and reaffirms my commitment to fight for a safe, free, and prosperous California. Now I have an important ask, and I hope you'll hear me out: could you take the next step to strengthen our campaign? In 3 months, voting begins for the June primary. Do you think you can donate once a month for 3 months? It's not a forever commitment. And you can change or cancel anytime. Why monthly? Because it helps us plan, budget, and stay steady. We have a lean team. Big business and public sector unions will never support us. We rely on YOU to fuel this entire operation: Yard signs, digital ads, voter contact, even gasoline — it all depends on folks like you who have skin in the game. Polls show us leading the entire field — we're ahead of Porter, Swalwell, and every Republican. And we've raised over $3.5 MILLION, shocking the establishment. But this is a marathon, and we need even more money to fight back against the Democrats, who will spend tens of millions to stop a Sheriff from becoming Governor. We need a group of committed supporters who can go the distance with us. However much you can afford to donate monthly, I thank you from the bottom of my heart: Thanks for being part of this. * We exposed ATI Government Solutions exploiting the SBA's 8(a) minority contracting program -- outsourcing 80% of their work while pocketing over $100 million in no-bid contracts. This wasn't a one-off. It was a systemic scheme across multiple agencies.

* A GAO director admitted on hidden camera that staff "stole and backed up" vaccine data specifically to block RFK Jr.'s HHS reforms. They weren't just resisting policy -- they were breaking federal law.
* **THE RESULT:** The director's profile was scrubbed. A federal investigation was launched. And the nation finally saw what "deep state resistance" actually looks like.

* **THE RESULT:** Contractor FIRED. NIH internal investigation launched. And a national conversation about the defiance embedded in our federal agencies.
* **4\. GEORGETOWN PROFESSOR EXPOSED (December)**
* We caught a Georgetown professor on hidden camera calling Black conservatives "coons" and mocking "stupid white people." When we confronted him, he tried to assault our cameraman. Police were called.
* **THE RESULT:** Georgetown wiped his bio from their website. The footage went viral -- over 2 million views. And elite academic bias was laid bare for all to see.
* **5\. INSIDE EPSTEIN 'S ISLAND (May-December)**
* We released the first-ever footage from inside Jeffrey Epstein's private island mansion. We confronted a DOJ Deputy Chief who admitted plans to redact Republicans from the Epstein files. We published unredacted photos that Democrats tried to hide.
* **THE RESULT:** DOJ was forced to respond. Media outlets issued corrections. Joe Rogan covered our findings. And the truth about elite corruption reached millions who had been kept in the dark.

body:
Help us reach voters before April 21.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/131?refcode=em20260209-153&t=1&akid=153%2E12592%2E2chwMH)
We’re working to stop Donald Trump and his MAGA Republican allies from rigging the upcoming midterm elections in a desperate attempt to cling onto power.
Right now, we’re fighting for an emergency amendment that does something powerful: it gives Virginia voters the power to restore fairness in our elections at the national level by voting to approve new congressional maps ahead of midterms.
On April 21, Virginians will have their voices heard.
Between now and then, everything comes down to voter education. We have to reach people across the Commonwealth, cut through misinformation, and make sure voters understand what’s at stake — and why voting **YES** matters.
That work doesn’t happen all at once. It happens **week-by-week**.
That’s why we’re asking our strongest supporters to step up with a weekly contribution through April 21. A weekly recurring gift — whether it’s $5, $10, or $25 — gives us the stability we need to plan ahead, respond quickly, and keep reaching voters right up until April 21.
[**If you believe in protecting democracy and fair elections all across the country this year, will you become a weekly donor today?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/389?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260209_1.0U9vMQ&amount=3&refcode=20260209-153&t=2&akid=153%2E12592%2E2chwMH)

Your weekly support helps power voter education, rapid response, and on-the-ground organizing when it matters most.
Together, we can level the playing field and make sure voters — not politicians — are in charge.
Thank you for standing with us,
Virginians for Fair Elections

# [If 5 Republicans switched, Democrats could take back the House NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/Teecd63e4-9ecf-4739-9c08-86af00f35061/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Republicans in Congress admit it in private: Donald Trump is dangerous, unstable, and out of control. But in public, they’ve done nothing. [Here’s their chance](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te667709f-f923-4f1c-829e-588de3c5d694/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). **If just 5 House Republicans switched to caucus with Democrats, Democrats would immediately control the House — and could start blocking Trump right now.** Not next year. Not after the midterms. Now. Let's make it happen. GOP Speaker Mike Johnson has turned the House into a rubber stamp for Trump. But with real adults back in charge, tools the House already has could be used -- oversight, subpoenas, and funding holds, etc. **This isn’t impossible. Nineteen House Republicans sit in districts Biden won.** They are vulnerable, and with Trump’s approval rating plummeting by the day, he’s grown truly toxic in many swing districts. It may be time for the rats to flee the sinking ship. But we need to ratchet up the pressure to make it happen. **[Add your name: Tell Republicans switch sides and stop Trump NOW.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta8685c40-e489-4f5c-9d7f-c19869480d53/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. Well, at this point, I’m almost losing track of all the reasons Pete Hegseth is unfit to serve.
In January, NPR obtained a memo from Pete Hegseth’s Pentagon laying out plans to review the “effectiveness” of allowing women to serve in ground combat roles.
Let’s be honest about what this is: sexist BS.
First, it was attacking transgender service members, kicking them out of the military, and banning their enlistment. Then it was the quiet purge of senior military leaders who didn’t fit Hegseth’s narrow ideological mold: white, Christian, cisgender men. And now, it’s calling into question the thousands of women who have served honorably, met the standards, and proven themselves in combat — all to satisfy Pete Hegseth’s right-wing culture war agenda.
Hegseth has been saying the quiet part out loud for years . In 2024, he went on a podcast and said women shouldn’t serve in combat roles, claiming without a shred of evidence that it makes the military “less effective” and “less lethal.”
That claim is offensive. And even more importantly, it’s false!
An Army study conducted between 2018 and 2023 found that women performed well in ground combat units — and in some cases outperformed their male counterparts. Military experts have been clear: this so-called review is a solution in search of a problem.
The Pentagon claims this is about maintaining standards, and that women in combat somehow “compromise” our national security. But rigorous training standards already exist, and these women have met or exceeded them.
Questioning their service doesn’t raise standards. It undermines morale, pushes qualified leaders out, and weakens our military readiness when it matters most.
But none of this is surprising when it comes to Pete Hegseth. We’re talking about the same person who mishandled sensitive operational details on Signal and endangered U.S. troops. Who tried to use taxpayer dollars for personal vanity projects like his very own makeup studio inside the Pentagon. Who has promoted extremist views, like criminalizing homosexuality and taking away women’s right to vote.
Pete Hegseth routinely puts his deeply troubling ideology and inflated ego ahead of troop safety and national security.

body:
I've voted in GOP primaries since the 1990s – but two opponents have ZERO Texas primary votes...

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us10.campaign-archive.com/?e=4d3fe76c62&u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=a1898232ea)

| | | | | | Peter,
In Texas, a solidly Republican state, the **real decisions are made in the Republican Primary**. That's where we choose the direction of our state and nation – supporting leaders like Donald Trump and Ted Cruz when it matters most.
I've consistently voted in **every Republican Primary** going back to the 1990s, showing up election after election to advance conservative principles. In fact, my two oldest children – ages 21 and 20 – have already voted in more Texas Republican Primaries and participated in more precinct and state conventions than **two of my opponents combined**.
Yet, my primary opponents **Mark Teixeira** and **Jason Cahill** have **NEVER voted in a single Texas Republican Primary**. They've offered plenty of excuses – being out of state or claiming it "doesn't matter" – but those ring hollow. Texas primaries are where the key choices are made, and they chose not to participate until now, when their own names are on the ballot.
Why should they ask you to show up and vote for them when they wouldn't do the same for proven conservatives like President Trump or Senator Cruz?
It's about leadership and commitment. Do we want someone who consistently shows up for our conservative values, or someone who only gets involved when it benefits them personally?
I'm deeply honored to be endorsed by [**State Senator Brian Birdwell**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=eafa9ce486&e=4d3fe76c62) – a true American hero who survived the 9/11 attack on the Pentagon, served our nation in the military (including overseas deployments to the Middle East where he never missed an election), and has now been [**nominated by President Trump**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=9a356b4310&e=4d3fe76c62) to serve as an Assistant Secretary of Defense.
Senator Birdwell knows what real dedication looks like, and that's why he's standing with me.
As the only candidate who has worked directly with President Trump since 2016, I'll fight alongside him in Congress to secure the border, cut wasteful spending, drain the swamp, and protect our God-given freedoms.
I humbly ask for your vote in the **Republican Primary on March 3, 2026** – **early voting starts February 17**(a week from tomorrow).
Please visit [**trey4tx.com**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=94d73447f2&e=4d3fe76c62) to learn more, [**volunteer**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=bcdc3e9de4&e=4d3fe76c62), or [**contribute**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=14212f6688&e=4d3fe76c62). Together, we'll keep TX-21 strong and conservative.
God bless you, and God bless Texas,
**Trey Trainor** Republican Candidate for Congress, TX-21
P.S. Here is a picture of me and my family at the 2018 Republican Party of Texas Convention in San Antonio—proof of our long-standing commitment to the conservative cause.

[**Hi Peter, it’s Pete Buttigieg, and today I am endorsing Rebecca Cooke for Congress in Wisconsin’s Third District. I want to share why this race matters so much.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125044624/600511141/-514805226?refcode=em-2.9.26-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDZhNjUzYi1lMTA1LWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDBkM2ExODk0MmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ayEWSzaWAsE14JOkXwbnpcYmXpq0K6vRyJDyGj28aBU=) A few weeks ago, I held a town hall in this western Wisconsin district, engaging residents to hear directly what they had to say about this moment in our country and in their lives. That frustration is rooted in something real: The basics of everyday life have become out of reach for so many families. In the United States of America, you shouldn’t have to choose between paying your health insurance premium and paying your mortgage. If we want to make that vision real in western Wisconsin – and across the country – we need leaders who actually understand what working families are going through. That’s why I’m proud to endorse Rebecca Cooke. Rebecca is a working-class leader who knows these challenges firsthand. She grew up in western Wisconsin, built small businesses, and worked service-industry jobs while making ends meet. She understands that priorities like affordable housing, rural health care, strong unions, and infrastructure that connects every community, aren’t abstract ideas or talking points, they’re essentials. ---|---|---
Source: MarineTraffic.com
U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers seized $70,737 in unreported currency from the captain of a Chinese-flagged cargo vessel after a routine boarding in the Port of Baltimore, CBP said in a [press release](https://substack.com/redirect/f7c11aa5-76e8-4668-a659-058ca41e2080?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
CBP said officers noticed before boarding that the ship's master had previously filed a Financial Crimes Enforcement Network Form 105 listing $34,480 during an earlier port call in Searsport, Maine.
Form 105 is a U.S. Treasury Department report used to disclose cross-border transportation of currency or monetary instruments. Ship captains are required to disclose when they are carrying bulk cash.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WCK27s348JydRefEX37W6pK3eSCbLXa0Q_zIQXVNvHk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=187420320)
CBP said officers learned the vessel's agent provided the master an additional $40,000 while the ship was in Maine. CBP said the master did not report that additional cash during the Baltimore inspection and did not amend the earlier FinCEN 105 to reflect the higher total.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c06ea07d-3672-4136-9354-f1d1dc8390b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: CBP.gov
Officers returned to the vessel for a more extensive examination, CBP said, and found $70,737 in the purser's safe. CBP said officers seized the cash and released the vessel to continue its trip.
"It is rare to see a commercial ship captain deliberately violate our nation's laws," Matthew Suarez, acting director of CBP's Baltimore Field Office, said in the release.
Suarez also tied the incident to broader national-security concerns, saying CBP expects such conduct from an "adversarial nation" and will keep a close eye on merchant vessels that are both flagged and operated by adversarial countries, according to the release.
CBP said the captain -- identified only as the master of the M/V Sheng Ning Hai, a bulk freighter -- failed to declare any currency during an inspection after the vessel arrived in Baltimore.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..Xq1cAwdshP9PStAV1bd9ak87jg6XVhwivpqD2noLekU?)
The ship is owned by COSCO Shipping Lines and is flagged in China, CBP said, adding that its parent company is China's state-owned COSCO Shipping.
Publicly available information shows the Sheng Ning Hai is currently in the Caribbean Sea en route to Mombasa, Kenya.
The origin of the $40,000 the captain of the Chinese state-owned vessel acquired in Maine is unknown...

body:
This is authoritarianism, and I refuse to stay silent.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125045966/600515083/150430950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDQ4YTVlNy1lMTA1LWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDBkM2ExODk0MmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QiMM5SztgeCUkD4vbrt7FX9iEe6QLOzBkuYtIauTLzI=&emci=f557ad1a-da05-f111-832e-000d3a18942f&emdi=4d48a5e7-e105-f111-832e-000d3a18942f&ceid=7731215)
---

| | Under Donald Trump, we are witnessing something I never thought I would see in the United States of America: federal agents acting like secret police. Trump's ICE agents are showing up without identification. They are disappearing people into unmarked vans. They are denying detainees access to attorneys. And in too many cases, they are harming — even killing — members of our communities. **This is authoritarianism,****_and I refuse to stay silent._** Here's what I've been doing to fight back and hold ICE accountable:
* I introduced the ICE and CBP Constitutional Accountability Act with Representative Andrea Salinas — legislation that gives Americans the ability to sue the federal government when ICE or CBP agents violate their constitutional rights.
* I partnered with Senator Ed Markey and Representative Pramila Jayapal on the ICE Out of Our Faces Act to ban ICE from weaponizing facial recognition technology to surveil, track, and intimidate people in our communities.
* I stood firm against giving DHS and ICE a blank check — refusing to rubber-stamp billions of dollars while lawless agents terrorize families and trample basic freedoms.

Let me be blunt: unidentified agents grabbing people off the street and throwing them into vans is what secret police do around the world. clean_body: This is authoritarianism, and I refuse to stay silent. | | | | Under Donald Trump, we are witnessing something I never thought I would see in the United States of America: federal agents acting like secret police. Trump's ICE agents are showing up without identification. They are disappearing people into unmarked vans. They are denying detainees access to attorneys. And in too many cases, they are harming — even killing — members of our communities. This is authoritarianism,and I refuse to stay silent. Here's what I've been doing to fight back and hold ICE accountable: I introduced the ICE and CBP Constitutional Accountability Act with Representative Andrea Salinas — legislation that gives Americans the ability to sue the federal government when ICE or CBP agents violate their constitutional rights. I partnered with Senator Ed Markey and Representative Pramila Jayapal on the ICE Out of Our Faces Act to ban ICE from weaponizing facial recognition technology to surveil, track, and intimidate people in our communities. I stood firm against giving DHS and ICE a blank check — refusing to rubber-stamp billions of dollars while lawless agents terrorize families and trample basic freedoms. Let me be blunt: unidentified agents grabbing people off the street and throwing them into vans is what secret police do around the world. It is not who we are, and it cannot be allowed to become normal here. This is a fight for accountability. A fight for transparency. And a fight to save our republic. Onward! body:
I am genuinely sorry, Peter.
Really, I am.
I am sorry some folks threaten to remove you from the GOP if you don't donate.
I am sorry some folks masquerade as President Trump to try and fool you.
I am sorry some folks don't even thank you for donating.
It is enough to drive you nuts. And I completely understand how you feel because I get the same messages. I'll get bombarded with texts and emails asking me for money but it's hard to tell who sends them all.
And if I do pitch in a few bucks, I'd probably get pestered even more - without any acknowledgement of my contribution.
It's wrong, and I'm doing things differently.
This is Steve Scalise. First of all, I want to personally thank you for everything you've done to help elect President Trump and Republicans thus far. [You are the lifeblood of the MAGA movement – and we only won with your hard work and support.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/Bu3gv7s9bYj_TslczYz8Q6fzsfTSe-DYv2dAm2IgKbzSQJiQYIotd_5VMUrnNO3TI9f9g7gVh5IkrPlo72x0VDVV4uun2m-_cJ_gDyRscLbdpiheW3Jjg5RGlE5E9X04gHle_-xmPkG1hSihH3-hMzPNDFGC0ovfY2ht1ulbgK0Lspl-grO8cAoU_XW7WZEemsvUMiq3-j9i2bvTDdpY-1U5hzRLqjPr3hO2Haxfm8OjfHTEI0N4nmfevt4JAWpfuuD9NCQqPEguVNQDXUAkkuimaG7J3ByW0lzJbgfwESTQnUmcfJaVzBC7NNw7MoPF3HrPwvEZiE-xnKA-Y8rBxO1SQBrMRveCGqh3vVgSDnfwd9XeSJaggkhzwxov1rqBuDRJooh4CZ-sVarB8sg_4nzQH723Nxt39nB4mHWPbXxNkaC-qQy7RYGSnyFgW5By_UGkwR3SO8o1Ww9kW9_bcmyJo9N7kKtMz2fx5WXK9R1l3pqEV8-HD28Qk8r9Cdi2RwpK6Eaid4iGUenBvj94Cgwos_pHDEINU5EMhB6s6rUuHp77NPOZcUVaxOydJVGXYZcAGlg2SjSOGER_CfFtniwHsjy1ZHI2dbQ8Dq-whxx_-9jEU1BazgbxS0VkCqmCaFYMlaifsGPVrQxyapPak34M1YVyd-0eC-Gpa9ZxdseEB5ycJPk0HzT4mXRMLnYCKwmjT5BlqdJ_yYtDtgasV_htJmjJCEqp9p_8vbHbIHr1PP-sGoMaLsrj40rOMI-PcO4yfPWxEzAYJm9uSTimXNmcje9K6r44RbKfC6GsnhMNLW_QFYdjmkdWUV9_BE8CMjxRpId2Eg/J8zSTQs91bRuY-ZUgoTXIqPvHBSXmFIR/17)

They're ALREADY unloading 50 million dollars into enough battleground districts to flip the House. They're ALREADY dragging President Trump into court.
[In other words, we really need some more support right now to keep fighting.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/RaE9j_K9L3agYN56NwYhBNOtunNBtNYrBuHSk7j53CgrP9NrhwutAMP1vVCiOqBA9CEw1RhzcwO2rT5MrVsoJmzh23Btak_ltesq5rBd88d9dJiTEHIlj1i8FWa6nTuAIbX_CLsYySlZYQXBhGO_j1rmn7enPQpWZC16Qm8JfuYc1_xAXvyE8beGV_XRcBN5piQ3pr9RTBZKKoPEi1WO3L4nHlTZLf6d7HJRBwLhRAESFnliiXiofuhdlZ0AOAv46P46G0fclVledQ1twfUHuTxGbc63e-aaAcHHKHk4xrABRzXIYKnABY_6640SMoz1tjqqeo7rTW2m7vGWBcQR65SkXf0MmEHwBnB69EVl22NP8aHH_BY5IXioqsOiQcK_V-33dlp0KIuiILU4eGStxIr4Cma9NwgoEI4mugt5vKlkOhWgyEUNfHxBGT0WGYZ_iInVR9fU2nZxrAqXxE0cq6pbtNjpWx9y60oeAf_KWOXnJkOv9f8sAdYIukXNU51cYz75mdrktaDN0Cyh3Cwy-NvkhfsmuSHKLHbavMhP6PkNj-n4K5h660iyNa4kPk352wQK3P0Gsyjr0fElnmxAAppkpG_-ImLwezSReL-ZR8a3exQimxqUinwncAEi88K6bq131ghMXZOkcxo33MrZofrl4SsEU7oedFlD9qOLbsCPs8YEVgoksqPDAFwQvTnHumwRCmqgpKoRXg6zyqmvt0w99GsDTQSjBbj4nSkLI_4UZB2VQcKlhKLuVCeRNwizv6S1CM5Hr940kqyyYqC8-bFwD56CLR_8NhZYDCjy8GENS4M9EqMFMxnQxybV-cmUzhOltthnUw/aHK-YJr4U-eZ0SrOOQkk6y6g_ICEzZz0/17)

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240676%2E444211%2EdBUHbl)
There is no rest for those who want to win.
That’s why, fresh on the heels of the stunning special election victory in Tarrant County, we have been traveling across Texas to raise and organize volunteers, register and stay in touch with young voters and beat the drum to ensure that we’re all responding with the urgency and action that this moment demands.
We are staying on offense, pressing the attack.
Monday, I traveled to Texas State in San Marcos. For more than seven hours, we worked with students on the campus, adding more than 400 people to our relational organizing program after first helping them get registered. The energy on this campus is always positive, with many students signing up to join us as volunteers as well.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/57091?c0=pbp-em-20260209-1.DUiDsm&refcode=ema20260209-240676&t=3&akid=240676%2E444211%2EdBUHbl)
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/57091?c0=pbp-em-20260209-1.DUiDsm&refcode=ema20260209-240676&t=4&akid=240676%2E444211%2EdBUHbl)
Tuesday, I was in San Antonio at UTSA where I joined an impromptu debate on the best path forward in the midst of a massive ICE protest. While some were encouraging violence and “burning down the system” including elections and voting, I made the case for peaceful, nonviolent power—like registering, voting, volunteering, protesting, and civil disobedience. Much like our day in San Marcos, we spent over six hours registering and helping students join our relational organizing program.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/57091?c0=pbp-em-20260209-1.DUiDsm&refcode=ema20260209-240676&t=5&akid=240676%2E444211%2EdBUHbl)
I also got the chance to see Juan, a young man that I’d met seven years ago when he performed at a tribute for the Walmart massacre victims at El Dorado in El Paso. He’s now a successful student at UTSA, making El Paso and Texas proud.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/57091?c0=pbp-em-20260209-1.DUiDsm&refcode=ema20260209-240676&t=6&akid=240676%2E444211%2EdBUHbl)
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/57091?c0=pbp-em-20260209-1.DUiDsm&refcode=ema20260209-240676&t=7&akid=240676%2E444211%2EdBUHbl)
Wednesday, I drove a few hours north to Waco where I helped our volunteers there register and stay in touch with students at the McLennan Community College. A much smaller campus than the previous two days, the slower traffic allowed for longer conversations and more opportunities to train our organizers and new volunteers.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/57091?c0=pbp-em-20260209-1.DUiDsm&refcode=ema20260209-240676&t=8&akid=240676%2E444211%2EdBUHbl)
That night we held a town hall meeting at Waco High in their new performing arts center. More than 300 people came out for a discussion on how we get from where we are to where we want to be. Many signed up afterwards to volunteer going forward. My iPhone reminded me that the first time I spoke at a public meeting in Waco was exactly nine years ago, on February 4, 2017. I’ve been coming here for a long time—it’s how we ensure that winning in Tarrant County, another supposedly reliably red county, is not a fluke. You show up, do the work, get people out to vote and win elections. We can win in Waco.

clean_body: There is no rest for those who want to win. That’s why, fresh on the heels of the stunning special election victory in Tarrant County, we have been traveling across Texas to raise and organize volunteers, register and stay in touch with young voters and beat the drum to ensure that we’re all responding with the urgency and action that this moment demands. We are staying on offense, pressing the attack. Monday, I traveled to Texas State in San Marcos. For more than seven hours, we worked with students on the campus, adding more than 400 people to our relational organizing program after first helping them get registered. The energy on this campus is always positive, with many students signing up to join us as volunteers as well. Tuesday, I was in San Antonio at UTSA where I joined an impromptu debate on the best path forward in the midst of a massive ICE protest. While some were encouraging violence and “burning down the system” including elections and voting, I made the case for peaceful, nonviolent power—like registering, voting, volunteering, protesting, and civil disobedience. Much like our day in San Marcos, we spent over six hours registering and helping students join our relational organizing program. I also got the chance to see Juan, a young man that I’d met seven years ago when he performed at a tribute for the Walmart massacre victims at El Dorado in El Paso. He’s now a successful student at UTSA, making El Paso and Texas proud. Wednesday, I drove a few hours north to Waco where I helped our volunteers there register and stay in touch with students at the McLennan Community College. A much smaller campus than the previous two days, the slower traffic allowed for longer conversations and more opportunities to train our organizers and new volunteers. That night we held a town hall meeting at Waco High in their new performing arts center. More than 300 people came out for a discussion on how we get from where we are to where we want to be. Many signed up afterwards to volunteer going forward. My iPhone reminded me that the first time I spoke at a public meeting in Waco was exactly nine years ago, on February 4, 2017. I’ve been coming here for a long time—it’s how we ensure that winning in Tarrant County, another supposedly reliably red county, is not a fluke. You show up, do the work, get people out to vote and win elections. We can win in Waco. Meeting people in person, helping them with their registration and the questions they have around voting and then prompting them to vote come election time makes a huge difference. That’s why we do what we do and why I’m so grateful for those who make it possible. Thank you, Beto

# Dow smashes 50,000 milestone as "Blockbuster" economy in 2026 beckons
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent **[hailed a"blockbuster" 2026 for the US economy](https://substack.com/redirect/d6422fe1-d7bf-4b08-b4ac-e92e54c65468?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/223787d1-f9d5-42f7-a8e3-c3fc0ebc80ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Sunday, predicting robust growth, job gains and rising real incomes as inflation cools toward the Fed's 2% target. His optimism follows the Dow Jones Industrial Average closing above 50,000 for the first time Friday, signaling confidence in President Trump's policies delivering for Main Street.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d6422fe1-d7bf-4b08-b4ac-e92e54c65468?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Dow milestone achieved** : The Dow Jones Industrial Average surpassed 50,000 points for the first time on Friday, with President Trump celebrating the historic high on Truth Social.
* **Strong growth forecast** : Bessent anticipates very strong economic expansion in 2026, fueled by a big cyclical recovery and gains in industrial and small-cap stocks.
* **"Main Street is about to prosper"** : Record Wall Street highs indicate upcoming prosperity for everyday Americans, including substantial tax refunds and bigger paychecks from the administration's agenda.
* **Inflation trends positive** : Cooling inflation is moving toward the Federal Reserve's 2% goal amid current strong growth, setting the stage for broader economic gains next year.

# Crypto crashes shatter VC dreams, after billions poured in
Plummeting crypto prices have plunged Bitcoin nearly 50% from its October peak and altcoins up to 70% yearly, **[rattling venture capitalists who poured $18.9 billion into startups](https://substack.com/redirect/223787d1-f9d5-42f7-a8e3-c3fc0ebc80ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in 2025 only to face an industry identity crisis as speculative Web3 bets falter and retail interest vanishes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/223787d1-f9d5-42f7-a8e3-c3fc0ebc80ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **VC Pivot Accelerates:** Crypto-native funds are shifting to traditional startup fundamentals like product-market fit and monetization, abandoning unproven Web3 categories.
* **Market Consolidation Hits:** Web3 has been deemed largely uninvestable, with investors fleeing NFTs gaming and incremental DeFi while favoring stablecoins, fintech and prediction markets.
* **Funds Diversify Aggressively:** Firms like Mechanism Capital Tangent and Multicoin Capital are expanding into deep tech AI robotics and adjacent sectors beyond pure crypto.
* **Capital Concentrates Sharply:** Nearly one-third of 2025's $18.9 billion VC funding flowed into just four major deals including Binance and Polymarket.

* * *
* * *
# Big Tech crumbles in $1 Trillion selloff
Big Tech stocks reeled from a bruising week that **[erased more than $1 trillion in market value,](https://substack.com/redirect/f47fa3d3-f3cc-40da-aeb8-74eea4ec8918?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** driven by investor fears over massive AI capital spending plans announced by Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Meta. The "Magnificent 7" suffered their worst weekly drop since April as markets digested soaring 2026 expenditures potentially nearing $700 billion amid the AI boom.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f47fa3d3-f3cc-40da-aeb8-74eea4ec8918?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive Capex Concerns:** Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Meta reported combined Q4 spending of $120 billion, with 2026 projections far exceeding expectations and rivaling small nations' GDPs.
* **Stock Performance Mixed:** Oracle surged 9% in recovery attempts while Amazon fell 2%, Alphabet dipped 1%, and Nvidia gained 3% as Big Tech traded unevenly Monday.
* **Worst Week Since April:** The Magnificent 7 posted their steepest decline since tariff-driven turmoil earlier, with broader jitters from AI infrastructure demand overshadowing strong cloud results.
* **Analyst Perspectives Vary:** Experts note potential volatility from high spending but highlight confidence in demand utilization, with some viewing capex as justified by exponential AI growth.
