# Cuba bans airline refueling amid Trump's anti-communist oil squeeze
Cuba has **[halted aviation fuel supplies to international airlines starting Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/cf97daf0-f1cc-4982-8fc6-27554e5d1609?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** due to severe shortages triggered by U.S. President Donald Trump's tariff threats on nations providing oil to the island, disrupting flights and exacerbating the communist nation's deepening energy crisis amid tightened American pressure.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cf97daf0-f1cc-4982-8fc6-27554e5d1609?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Refueling ban imposed** : Cuba suspended jet fuel availability for all international carriers at its airports for one month, forcing long-haul flights to seek alternative stops and cutting a key government revenue source.
* **Trump tariff threats** : The U.S. president issued warnings of tariffs on any country supplying oil to Cuba, following an executive order labeling the island a national emergency threat over ties to Russia, China, and Iran.
* **Broader energy measures** : Cuban authorities imposed fuel rationing, closed some tourist sites, shortened school hours, and reduced state worker weeks to four days as the crisis worsens after Venezuela oil flows ended.
* **International reactions** : Russia called Cuba's fuel situation "truly critical" due to U.S. actions, while Mexico pledged humanitarian aid and diplomatic efforts to resume oil shipments despite pressure.

* * *
* * *
# Pressure mounts on American Airlines CEO as it trails rivals
American Airlines CEO Robert Isom **[faces mounting criticism from pilots and flight attendants](https://substack.com/redirect/d27e9d60-8307-479f-be3c-75615b4230c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the carrier posted meager 2025 profits, lagged far behind Delta and United, and struggled with a slow recovery from major winter storms in early 2026. Unions are questioning his leadership while Isom vows a transformative push toward premium offerings in a make-or-break year.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d27e9d60-8307-479f-be3c-75615b4230c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Union leaders challenge:** Pilots and flight attendants publicly criticize Isom's strategy and performance, citing underperformance and lack of clear direction amid rival success.
* **Profit-sharing disappoints:** Employees receive minimal bonuses due to near-breakeven 2025 results, with Isom expressing personal disappointment over the small pool.
* **Premium shift accelerates:** AA is betting on upscale cabins, lounge expansions, and luxury amenities like caviar to drive half of revenue from premium by decade's end.
* **Storm recovery criticized:** Severe winter disruptions stranded crews and drew union ire, marking the most impactful weather event in Isom's tenure.

* * *
* * *
# Goldman warns SaaS software rout is just the beginning
Goldman Sachs issued a stark warning Monday that the brutal 2026 sell-off in "Software as a Service" (SaaS) stocks **[may escalate into a prolonged rout,](https://substack.com/redirect/236616e7-a9b6-4913-9a2f-c9cb8b1ab9ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** likening AI's disruptive threat to the internet's devastation of newspapers, which saw average 95% share price declines over years. Investors face deep uncertainty over earnings stability amid rapid AI advances hammering firms like Salesforce, Oracle, and ServiceNow.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/236616e7-a9b6-4913-9a2f-c9cb8b1ab9ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **AI threatens terminal values:** Goldman highlights existential risks to software companies' long-term earnings and valuations from advancing AI agents automating tasks in legal, sales, marketing, and analysis.
* **Historical disruption parallel:** Strategist Ben Snider compares current AI fears to newspaper stocks' 95% average drop from 2002-2009, noting price stability needs earnings outlook stability.
* **Sector suffers record lag:** Software stocks are underperforming the Nasdaq by the widest margin this century, with no clear buy-the-dip catalysts emerging amid negative news flow.
* **Specific stocks hammered:** Notable declines include 27% drops in Oracle and Salesforce, plus 41% in Figma since its 2025 IPO, with broader pain hitting Workday, SAP, Thomson Reuters, and others.

### Monday.com stock plunges 19% on AI fears
Monday.com shares crater 19% after weak 2026 guidance overshadowed strong Q4 results, **[as investors fret over AI tools potentially disrupting traditional software models](https://substack.com/redirect/389153a5-ea89-4936-94dd-7055eba4a302?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** like its project management platform.
* **Guidance disappoints Wall Street** : Fiscal 2026 revenue projected at $1.452-1.462 billion (18-19% growth), below analyst expectations of $1.48 billion, with operating margins pressured by FX rates and AI investments.
* **Strong Q4 beats estimates** : Revenue hit $333.9 million (up 25% YoY) and adjusted EPS $1.04, surpassing forecasts, with record high-value customer adds and rapid AI product traction like monday vibe reaching $1M ARR quickly.
* **AI pivot amid disruption fears** : Company accelerates AI-native features including sidekick, vibe, agents, and workflows to boost engagement, while insisting no current impact from external AI competitors.
* **Broader software sell-off context** : monday.com shares down 50% YTD amid sector rout, with software ETF IGV off 22%, fueled by worries that agentic AI could replace SaaS business models.

name: Amy Klobuchar
subject: It wasn’t an easy decision to make
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Minnesotans for Klobuchar _
body:
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-klobuchar-2026.A9531n&refcode=em260209-1-b&t=1&akid=11241%2E3935704%2ErpFmJ8)
---
Hi there —
I wanted you to be one of the first to hear the news: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota.**This is a home-grown campaign, born in a moment like no other.**
[**I’m going to tell you why in a moment. But first: Will you help us get off to a strong start by splitting a donation between GIFFORDS and my campaign?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-klobuchar-2026.A9531n&refcode=em260209-1-b&t=2&akid=11241%2E3935704%2ErpFmJ8)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-klobuchar-2026.A9531n&refcode=em260209-1-b&t=3&akid=11241%2E3935704%2ErpFmJ8)**
I’m not going to sugar coat it -- Minnesota has been through a lot.
The killings of two innocent Minnesotans. Three thousand ICE agents on our streets and in our towns, sent by an administration that relishes division. Minnesotans stood up. Our state has been the center of America’s heartbreak. But we have also been the center of America's courage and America's hope. In moments of enormous difficulty, we find strength in our Minnesota values of hard work, freedom, and simple decency and good will.
**These moments call for grit and resilience.** I’ve learned resilience from the people of Minnesota. They have stood up, they have marched, and they have brought food to their neighbors. Through it all we do not give up.
And grit? I learned that from my family. I’m the daughter of a newspaperman and a proud union member teacher. My grandpa worked 1,500 feet underground in the mines on the Iron Range, and he saved his money in a coffee can in the basement to send my dad to college. I wouldn’t be where I am today without them.
**These times call for leaders who can stand up and not be rubber stamps of this administration.** But who are also willing to find common ground and fix things in our state.
I led our state’s biggest prosecutors’ office for eight years and then you gave me the honor of serving as your United States Senator. I was ranked number one in the Senate for bipartisan bills and number three out of one hundred for getting bills passed into law.
**I will do my job without fear or favor. I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful. That’s what I did as a prosecutor. That’s what I did as senator. And that’s what I will do as your governor.**
I believe we must stand up for what’s right. And fix what’s wrong. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids, for everyone who wants more affordable healthcare. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to protect our democracy and get ICE and its abusive tactics out of the state we love
And I'm running for every student, farmer, dreamer and builder.

Friends -

In November, myself and five other Members of Congress made a video quoting current law, that the military has a responsibility to refuse illegal orders.

In response, President Trump tweeted more than a dozen times, calling for me to be investigated, arrested, and hanged.

Since then, the FBI and former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, now U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me for the inquiry.

I wanted to share an important update on all of this, and ask for your help.

I wrote to Attorney General Pam Bondi and U.S. Attorney Pirro to inform them that I won’t be doing an interview -- and that their offices should preserve their records should I decide to sue for their infringement on my Constitutional rights.

I am not going to legitimize what they’re doing. The video in question was public, and I’ve talked about it extensively in the open. Our Constitution is crystal clear about our freedom of speech – and that’s a value worth fighting for.

To be honest, very smart people have told me to keep my head down and be quiet – that doing so would make this inquiry go away. But that’s exactly what Trump and Pirro want. They are employing physical and legal intimidation to get me to shut up. And, much more importantly, to deter other people from criticizing them.

So I’m taking the opposite approach, and I am fighting back, because this is bigger than any one Senator or any one video. If they can do this to me, what can they do to a business leader or the head of a community foundation or a mom who goes viral on the internet for criticizing Donald Trump?

And what people like Jeanine Pirro need to understand is that while the President of the United States may have immunity according to the Supreme Court, those who do his bidding do not. And if they are going to salute and do what he wants as part of this weaponization, they are going to own those consequences.

We all own our choices. I own mine. And Pirro and Trump must own theirs. This is where I need your help. As I've said before, fighting back against these abuses of power requires a political strategy and a legal strategy. Peter, these days it can be hard to keep up with the constant attacks on fair representation, alongside everything else in the news. Even for us who do this work, it can feel overwhelming and exhausting. It’s worth noting that President Trump and his MAGA allies want us to feel that way. It’s why their primary strategy these days is sowing chaos in pursuit of their own power. What’s getting lost in the flurry of chaos and confusion is one of their most consequential attacks on democracy itself: **undermining the U.S. Census.** A new federal lawsuit is trying to prevent an accurate count in the 2030 Census — they don’t want the Census Bureau to count people who are not citizens. **Let me stop right here to say that this is as unconstitutional as it gets.** The 14th Amendment lays out in no uncertain terms that everyone — literally “every person” — must be counted. In any other era, these kinds of egregious tactics would likely be dead on arrival. But Trump and his allies have shown that they are willing to disregard the rule of law to try to get their way, or hope to find a Trump-friendly court to side in their favor. [**So we must prepare to fight back now to end threats like this, not to mention other countless attacks on democracy and voting rights, in their tracks. Make a donation if you can and help protect our representative democracy.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125049703/600529020/-2069046819?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_CensusUnderAttack_email_20260209-NDRC-Tier1-CensusUnderAttack_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260209-NDRC-Tier1-CensusUnderAttack_&utm_campaign=CensusUnderAttack&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4ZjYzZWIyLWViMDUtZjExMS04MzJlLTAwMGQzYTE4OTQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3cd2jqZS6e06gtldhf0rUgREkP7VgpcgxGAaF0D2eiM=) There’s no doubt: Any successful effort to undermine the census will land a devastating blow to American democracy. And they’re throwing the kitchen sink at us. Here’s the thing: The fair maps movement fought back and defeated outrageous attacks on the census last time around — and we won. These guys are beatable. **Together, we must meet this urgent moment with urgent action.[Your gift today will strengthen the NDRC’s critical fight against anti-democracy attacks across the country.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125049706/600529022/-2069046819?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_CensusUnderAttack_email_20260209-NDRC-Tier1-CensusUnderAttack_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260209-NDRC-Tier1-CensusUnderAttack_&utm_campaign=CensusUnderAttack&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4ZjYzZWIyLWViMDUtZjExMS04MzJlLTAwMGQzYTE4OTQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3cd2jqZS6e06gtldhf0rUgREkP7VgpcgxGAaF0D2eiM=)** Thank you for rising above the noise to take action, Marina Jenkins

clean_body: When fair representation is attacked, we fight back to ensure every voice is heard. | Peter, these days it can be hard to keep up with the constant attacks on fair representation, alongside everything else in the news. Even for us who do this work, it can feel overwhelming and exhausting. It’s worth noting that President Trump and his MAGA allies want us to feel that way. It’s why their primary strategy these days is sowing chaos in pursuit of their own power. What’s getting lost in the flurry of chaos and confusion is one of their most consequential attacks on democracy itself: undermining the U.S. Census. A new federal lawsuit is trying to prevent an accurate count in the 2030 Census — they don’t want the Census Bureau to count people who are not citizens. Let me stop right here to say that this is as unconstitutional as it gets. The 14th Amendment lays out in no uncertain terms that everyone — literally “every person” — must be counted. In any other era, these kinds of egregious tactics would likely be dead on arrival. But Trump and his allies have shown that they are willing to disregard the rule of law to try to get their way, or hope to find a Trump-friendly court to side in their favor. = There’s no doubt: Any successful effort to undermine the census will land a devastating blow to American democracy. And they’re throwing the kitchen sink at us. Here’s the thing: The fair maps movement fought back and defeated outrageous attacks on the census last time around — and we won. These guys are beatable. Together, we must meet this urgent moment with urgent action.= Thank you for rising above the noise to take action, Marina Jenkins Executive Director, National Democratic Redistricting Committee | = = | | Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President. | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|--- National Democratic Redistricting Committee 712 H St NE, #25 Washington, DC 20002 United States if you'd like to receive fewer emails from the NDRC. | | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7hum&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7hum&__onlt=h)**

---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7hum&__onlt=h)**

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

_**"Would you negotiate with the Democrats over ICE deporting illegal aliens?"**_

clean_body: It's time to deliver for the American people. | Fellow American, I had the privilege to speak alongside President Trump in the Oval Office, and this question came up... "Would you negotiate with the Democrats over ICE deporting illegal aliens?" The only logical answer is that the Left is made up of complete, radical nut jobs. They want to blame Stephen Miller, Kristi Noem. They want to blame me, and they definitely want to blame President Trump. But the root of the problem is sanctuary cities. As long as 12 states have sanctuary policies, illegal aliens will keep coming. I will not stop working to help President Trump secure our borders and make our cities safer. That means ending sanctuary cities across the country. Our brave men and women in law enforcement hate sanctuary city policies - there's tremendous fraud around them, and it's encouraging more people to come here illegally. Bottom line, it is the policies Chuck Schumer and Democrats are trying to push. We saw how the immigration crisis grew under President Joe Biden. The President supports eliminating sanctuary cities. Let's deliver my bill to make sanctuary cities illegal across America and end the chaos for good. You're either with Chuck Schumer or you're with President Trump and me. The choice is clear. Lindsey Graham P.S. This election is about who you trust to keep our border secure. President Trump and me... or Chuck Schumer and Democrats. Data shows that, in courts with the highest deportation rates, over 90% of cases involving people in detention ended in removal orders. And over the past five years, 62% of immigrants without a lawyer were deported compared to 27% of those with legal aid.1

clean_body: Your support for the Defending Our Neighbors Fund today will create a lifeline for impacted families. | | | Peter, safety in our communities starts with us: checking in on our neighbors, showing solidarity, and defending fairness and justice for all. You might have taken action locally, but if you’re ready to stand with immigrants across the country, the Defending Our Neighbors Fund allows you to do just that. Through this fund, we can rush resources directly to frontline organizations that provide legal support to individuals and families as they face existential threats to their dignity, safety, and lives. | | Today, there are more than 6.2 million mixed-status households in the U.S. facing the threat of separation. Access to legal support can make a profound difference in keeping families together. Data shows that, in courts with the highest deportation rates, over 90% of cases involving people in detention ended in removal orders. And over the past five years, 62% of immigrants without a lawyer were deported compared to 27% of those with legal aid.1 Your support for the Defending Our Neighbors Fund creates a lifeline for impacted families. Everyday people like you have already stepped up to protect everyone’s right to due process, ensure families can stay together, and increase access to high-quality legal representation and bond assistance. | ** Thank you for defending your neighbors, upholding fairness, and advocating for justice for all. — Greisa, United We Dream 1. “Where Can You Win in Immigration Court? The Impact of Lawyers, Detention, Geography, and Policy.” American Immigration Council. November 20, 2025. Follow us on: | | | | |

** The Crisis of Homes
------------------------------------------------------------

There are multiple steps we can take in the battle to reduce the price of homeownership in America, as the share of first-time home buyers dropped to a record low of 21% in 2025. in In just 15 years, the average U.S. homebuyer went from 39 to 59 years old (https://fortune.com/2025/11/13/average-homebuyer-59-years-old-senior-citizen-housing-market-affordability/?mc_cid=8e575d420e&mc_eid=UNIQID) , according to fortune. this is largely due to historically low inventories. Fortunately there are steps we can take to fix this.

Interesting statistics from the National Association of Realtors (https://www.nar.realtor/newsroom/first-time-home-buyer-share-falls-to-historic-low-of-21-median-age-rises-to-40?mc_cid=8e575d420e&mc_eid=UNIQID) :

** First-time Buyers
------------------------------------------------------------
* Median age: 40 years old
* 10% median down payment – matching the highest level recorded since 1989
* Top sources for down payment:
+ Personal savings (59%)
+ Financial assets – such as a 401(k), stocks, or cryptocurrency (26%)
+ Gifts or loans from family and friends (22%)

** Repeat Buyers
------------------------------------------------------------
* Median age: 62 years old
* 23% median down payment
* 30% were all-cash buyers

** All Buyers
------------------------------------------------------------
* Median age: 59 years old
* 24% have children under the age of 18 living at home – an all-time low
* 14% purchased a multi-generational home – down from 17% in 2024
* Top reasons cited for purchasing a multi-generational home:
+ Take care of aging parents (41%)
+ Cost savings (29%)
+ Children over the age of 18 moving back home (27%)

** All Sellers
------------------------------------------------------------
* Median time in home before selling: 11 years – an all-time high
* Median distance moved: 30 miles – down from 35 miles last year
* 50% purchased a newer home
* 34% purchased a larger home

** Use of Real Estate Agents
------------------------------------------------------------
* 88% of all home buyers used an agent or broker
* 92% of buyers of previously owned homes relied on an agent or broker
* 91% of buyers would use their agent again or recommend them to others
* 91% of sellers used an agent – equal to the highest percentage on record

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: I believe in the power of people
body:
People across the country are coming together and refusing to be scared into silence by our government.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Recently, I’ve been asked by a lot of people on the road how things are going and how I keep believing in the face of so much of what’s happening across the country.
But it’s been easier for me because I get to see how hard Texans are fighting for change. The determination of people all over this state, doing their thing, having their plan with their people to be the difference — it’s so inspiring. And I get to encounter it every day as part of this campaign.
People across the nation are standing up for their neighbors. People supporting one another. People showing courage and humanity when those in power want to silence us.
It’s as clear now as it’s ever been: **While the government is broken, the people are not.**
While politicians choose corruption and division, people are choosing community. We are refusing the lies. We are refusing to be scared into silence. And that is how change has always started — by people deciding they will not accept what they are being told is normal.
This is a powerful moment. It is hard, but I’m hopeful. And if we keep showing up together, we will change things for the better.
**[If you are with me, please chip in $5 or any amount today to help build the people-powered campaign we need to win in November.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260209_1_govbroken.Jmy4Pm&refcode=em20260209-553&amount=5&t=1&akid=553%2E299639%2EEPhiUq)**

Thank you for being a part of this movement, Peter.
Gina

Hi friend & neighbor,

I'm not sure if you've been following the news out of Salem, but here's what happening: Oregonians spoke loud and clear,
submitting more than 250,000 signatures (three times what was needed!) to give voters a say on the Democrats' new 6-cent gas tax
hike that would cost us billions in the next decade.

Governor Kotek then announced she wanted the Legislature to repeal it during February's short session. But according to an opinion
from the Attorney General, the Legislature cannot repeal a bill once it has qualified for a referendum vote by the people.

But Democrats are desperate to not let their botched attempt to raise taxes hurt their chances on November's ballot, so now
they've introduced SB 1599 to rush the process, silence Oregonians' chance to submit arguments to the Voters Pamphlet, and hold
the vote during May's Primary - not November's General Election like petitioners signed up for!

Surely Salem Democrats are learning that Oregonians don't want to pay more in taxes, right? WRONG. They are also proposing HB 4015
to "disconnect" from the federal tax code to cost hard-working Oregonians the millions in tax savings Trump's Big Beautiful Bill
promised as a means of helping backfill their declining state revenues rather than curb their unchecked spending.

When is enough, enough? I need to hear from you.

1. Should the gas tax referral vote be held during November's General Election as planned, or should we rush the process to move
it to May's Primary Election?

2. Should Oregonians receive the same federal tax breaks on their state income taxes, or should we pay more by disconnecting from
the federal tax code?

[] Hi friend & neighbor, I'm not sure if you've been following the news out of Salem, but here's what happening: Oregonians spoke loud and clear, submitting more than 250,000 signatures (three times what was needed!) to give voters a say on the Democrats' new 6-cent gas tax hike that would cost us billions in the next decade. Governor Kotek then announced she wanted the Legislature to repeal it during February's short session. But according to an opinion from the Attorney General, the Legislature cannot repeal a bill once it has qualified for a referendum vote by the people. But Democrats are desperate to not let their botched attempt to raise taxes hurt their chances on November's ballot, so now they've introduced SB 1599 to rush the process, silence Oregonians' chance to submit arguments to the Voters Pamphlet, and hold the vote during May's Primary - not November's General Election like petitioners signed up for! Surely Salem Democrats are learning that Oregonians don't want to pay more in taxes, right? WRONG. They are also proposing HB 4015 to "disconnect" from the federal tax code to cost hard-working Oregonians the millions in tax savings Trump's Big Beautiful Bill promised as a means of helping backfill their declining state revenues rather than curb their unchecked spending. When is enough, enough? I need to hear from you. 1. Should the gas tax referral vote be held during November's General Election as planned, or should we rush the process to move it to May's Primary Election? 2. Should Oregonians receive the same federal tax breaks on their state income taxes, or should we pay more by disconnecting from the federal tax code? subject: Charlie's final book wasn't about politics...
body:
[unsubscribe](https://trk.trumpshowdown.com/?xul=1bu7fz54lr1j98ye80ci7qlvw538dmig8psrs8oll1qkd47a5udirbycbovruakmtaspj8kb1gf0jly3ldv3szuxp9964w7uovvhju&__stmp=ta7k2l&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.trumpshowdown.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7k2l&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.trumpshowdown.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7k2l&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.trumpshowdown.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7k2l&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.trumpshowdown.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7k2l&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.trumpshowdown.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7k2l&__onlt=h)**
---

**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.trumpshowdown.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ta7k2l&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, “We’re not backing down.” This is what Charlie prayed for. I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too. None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith. Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God. I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible. # MEMORANDUM

To: Valued Supporters
From: Michael Biundo & Derek Dufresne, Partners – Ascent Strategic
Date: February 5, 2026
Re: Lily Tang Williams – Record-Breaking Fundraising Momentum & Why It Matters in NH-02

Dear Valued Supporters,

Lily Tang Williams is proving something important in New Hampshire’s 2nd Congressional District: when you speak plainly about the issues that actually affect working families, the support follows, and it follows fast.

In 2025, Lily raised over $532,000 from donors. Every dollar came from individuals, small businesses, families, and Americans who believe in her message. In addition, with her own $120,000 personal loan to the campaign, total receipts reached over $652,000. That donor-raised number puts her ahead of every other Republican running for the U.S. House in New Hampshire this cycle in non-candidate, grassroots-raised dollars. She enters 2026 with more than $507,000 cash on hand, built almost entirely from donor support. She views that personal loan as her own investment in getting the fundraising operation up and running early, a down payment that helped turn thousands of supporters into donors.

On the spending side, the campaign used approximately $278,000 in 2025. Much of that went directly towards the costs of raising funds: email fundraising, digital advertising, direct mail, events, and outreach that turned interest into contributions. That is a normal and necessary part of building a strong donor base from the ground up, and the results speak for themselves: strong, sustained support from people across New Hampshire and beyond.

Even though she currently faces no challenger in the NH-02 Republican primary, Lily’s fundraising performance already surpasses that of congressional candidates in New Hampshire’s 1st Congressional District. Her lead in donor-raised money and cash-on-hand shows the kind of early momentum that matters most, the kind built from real people.

Her fundraising strength and her strong showing last cycle, when she was the Republican nominee, have so far kept a real primary challenger at bay. In a state like New Hampshire, where the primary is one of the latest in the country (typically early September), that deterrence is huge. It gives her a massive head start: more time to build an organization, more resources to reach voters, and more runway to lock in support before anyone else can mount a serious campaign.

She is also far ahead of where past Republican nominees in NH-02 stood at this same point in their cycles. At the end of the year before the election, previous non-incumbent nominees typically had $0 to $100,000 in cash on hand. Lily’s $507,000 puts her roughly 5 to 10 times ahead of the next-closest historical benchmark for this stage, a clear sign of the strength she is bringing to the table early.

NH-02 hasn’t been uncompetitive; rather, it’s been unchallenged. The margins we’ve seen are the product of minimal investment, not structural safety. In midterm elections, the district’s large share of undeclared voters, rural and exurban communities, and lower-propensity Democratic turnout create a fundamentally more volatile electorate than top-line results suggest. With real resources and a credible candidate, NH-02 tightens quickly, often faster than NH-01, because fewer voters are locked into partisan voting patterns and persuasion still meaningfully moves the outcome.

This is not her first time exceeding expectations. In 2024, as a candidate with no prior elected office, Lily over-performed every realistic forecast in the NH-02 Republican primary. She earned strong support across the district, outperforming predictions despite running against opponents with far more name recognition and institutional backing. That experience proved she can connect with voters and build real momentum, and the numbers in 2025 show she’s doing it again, even stronger.

She grew up under communism in China. She came to America with nothing, built a business from the ground up, and raised a family here. She knows what it feels like when government gets too big, too expensive, and too far removed from the people it’s supposed to serve. That background is not just biography. It is why she fights the way she does. And it is why regular people are stepping up to back her.

New Hampshire’s 2nd District is more Republican-leaning than many places, but do not let that fool you. The same entrenched interests, the same insider games, and the same refusal to listen to everyday taxpayers exist here too. Lily is running into many of the same hurdles any outsider faces when challenging the status quo: well-funded opponents, establishment networks, and a system that often rewards longevity over results.

Yet she has already built the strongest non-candidate fundraising operation among NH Republicans running for Congress this cycle, both in money raised and money in the bank. That matters. It means she can reach voters directly, tell her story without apology, and compete on the issues that actually keep Granite State families up at night: inflation, energy costs, border security, and government that spends like it is someone else’s money.

Every dollar Lily has raised is going towards one goal: making sure the people’s voice is heard louder than the lobbyists’ and the career politicians’. She is not asking for special treatment. She is asking for accountability. And the response from donors across New Hampshire and across the country shows that message is landing.

We are still early in this cycle, but the foundation is already stronger than almost anyone expected. To keep that momentum going, to make sure Lily has the resources to fight the fights that need to be fought, we need your help now.

If you believe New Hampshire deserves a representative who puts families first, who understands what real struggle looks like, and who will never forget where she came from, then please consider joining us with a contribution today.

Donate securely at:
[https://www.lilytangwilliams.com/congress/donate/](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=be9d61e5f6&e=c338950e03). For larger gifts, or to discuss matching opportunities, reach out to either of us directly by email at _[Michael@Ascent-Strategic](mailto:Michael Biundo <michael@ascent-strategic.com>)_ and _[Derek@Ascent-Strategic.com](mailto:Derek Dufresne <derek@ascent-strategic.com>)_.

Thank you for standing with Lily. This is not just about winning an election. It is about restoring a government that actually works for the people again.

Sincerely,

Michael Biundo & Derek Dufresne
Partners
Ascent Strategic

body:
The GOP sees this race as one of their best opportunities to flip a Senate seat.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260209_1.kUny3p&refcode=em20260209-1&t=1&akid=5036%2E582294%2EuK6Nrj)
I know what it’s like to run against a Republican with high name ID and a national donor network behind him — I’ve done it before. And I won.
Now, Chris Pappas is facing the same kind of threat in New Hampshire. National Republicans managed to recruit former Senator John Sununu into the race — and the latest polling shows this race will be close.
Look, in order for Democrats to take back the Senate majority and put an end to Trump’s unchecked power, winning in New Hampshire is absolutely critical.
**[That’s why I’m in this fight with everything I’ve got. And why I’m asking you to please pitch in $5 right now to help Chris Pappas stand up to big-money Republicans, compete against John Sununu, and keep this seat blue.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260209_1.kUny3p&refcode=em20260209-1&t=2&akid=5036%2E582294%2EuK6Nrj)**
**[Donate $5 to support Chris Pappas »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260209_1.4935YC&refcode=em20260209-1&t=3&akid=5036%2E582294%2EuK6Nrj)**
Chris is a Granite Stater through and through. He’s not in this for power or prestige or to cozy up to billionaires. _He’s in it to make life better for working families — the folks who get up every day, work hard, and are struggling to get by._ He’s fought Big Pharma to lower prescription drug prices, stood up for veterans, and protected reproductive rights when they’ve been under relentless attack.
Chris Pappas fights for the people — not the wealthy and well-connected. He shows up, he listens, and he gets things done. That’s what New Hampshire needs, and it’s what working people across the country need.
**But Republicans know New Hampshire is one of their best shots at flipping a Senate seat this year.** Sununu has the name recognition, the right-wing billionaire network, and the full weight of the national GOP behind him.
We’ve seen this before. Special interests will flood races with corporate money and try to buy Senators who will work for them instead of their constituents. We can’t let this happen in New Hampshire.
**If you believe, like I do, that government ought to work for working people — not the rich and powerful —[then I’m asking you to please chip in to Chris’s campaign now to help him compete and win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260209_1.kUny3p&refcode=em20260209-1&t=4&akid=5036%2E582294%2EuK6Nrj)**
I know Chris has what it takes to win this race. But we all need to make sure he has the resources to fight back against this massive right-wing spending.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country in 2026. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

| | Fellow Patriot,
---
| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

clean_body: A radical act of trust.| | | | | Fellow Patriot, | | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus. He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Fellow Patriot, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Fellow Patriot, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... And a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S.Stop, in the Name of God is Charlie Kirk's final message -- written in obedience, shaped by Scripture, and grounded in trust in the Lord. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

Peter,
After seeing young men shift to the right in the 2024 election, the immediate reaction was to assume that they were unreachable, lost to the Republican Party for good.
But that’s not the whole story.
As Trump’s second term began to unfold, something changed. The campaign promises weren’t matching reality. Young men began souring on Trump over the economy.
Because when budgets get tighter, rent keeps climbing, and you get laid off or can’t find a job, it prompts us to ask ourselves, “who is actually on our side?”
**That shift tells us something crucial: Young men are persuadable.**
Not because of podcasters or culture war messaging, but because there’s a real desire to be heard by leaders who will finally address what life feels like right now. Leaders who will talk honestly about the economy and will push for real solutions that make life more affordable and secure.

body:
The people are waking up and fighting back.
#
Hey Peter,
In the NJ-11 Special Primary election, **AIPAC poured $2 million** into negative ads against Tom Malinowski for saying he wouldn’t “write a blank check” for Israel. They endorsed Tahesha Way, the former Lieutenant Governor.
The results are too close to call, but **the likely winner, Analilia Mejia, pulled a surprise lead in the crowded race.** She’s been strongly against dark money and has been loudly against the genocide in Gaza. **AIPAC did not win.**
**[In February, AIPAC spent $400,000 on ads for my opponent. Will you join Justice Democrats in supporting me today so we can fight back?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260209-ja.lat6_7&refcode=em20260209-37450&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=37450%2E1203867%2Eg5XYWd)**
**In Congress, I won't back down from...**
📌 **Declaring a comprehensive arms embargo** and the ending of all military aid to Israel.
📌 **Realizing the self-determination** of the Palestinian people and an end to the Israeli occupation.
📌 **Ensuring equal protection** and Right of Return for Palestinians under international law.
**[Fight Back Today](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260209-ja.lat6_7&refcode=em20260209-37450&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=37450%2E1203867%2Eg5XYWd)**
**In February, AIPAC spent $400,000 on ads for my opponent and “Wall Street’s favorite Democrat,” Melissa Bean.** AIPAC has been trying to buy races all over the country to ensure campaigns like ours that stand up for Palestinian rights don’t win.
They’ve spent millions of dollars to rig elections in their favor, and we must work together for all our rights. NJ-11 showed us it’s possible, but **I need your help now.**
**[Will you split a donation today between Justice Democrats to make sure we have the money we need to stand against dark money groups like AIPAC?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260209-ja.lat6_7&refcode=em20260209-37450&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=37450%2E1203867%2Eg5XYWd)**

It’s going to take all of us to reject the dark money, like AIPAC, that has been rotting out politics in this country for decades. But if we stand together, **we will win.**
In solidarity,
Junaid

Hi Peter I'm Scott Kelly - former NASA Astronaut, retired U.S. Navy Captain and resident of CO district 4.
I've been to space 4 times and spent nearly a year on the International Space Station (ISS). I commanded both the Space Shuttle and the ISS and flew with more than 40 people from across the world--scientists, engineers, doctors--men and women of every background, faith, and nationality. We didn't share the same backgrounds, but we shared a mission: work together, stay focused, and deliver.
That's the kind of leadership and focus we need in Congress. That's what Trisha Calvarese brings to the table.
I'm proud to endorse Trisha Calvarese in Colorado's 4th District.
Trisha is running to defeat Lauren Boebert - and I'm proud to endorse her in this critical mission.
Trisha grew up here on the rural Eastern Plains and in Douglas County. She served our country as a civil servant and returned home to care for her sick parents at the end of their lives. She understands the people of this district because she's actually one of us. She's running for Congress to stand up for the dignity and care of families in her hometown.
That means protecting Social Security and Medicare. It means working to bring down the cost of everything from prescription drugs to groceries. It means investing again in U.S. science and engineering to create good-paying jobs and opportunities. Trisha's ready to actually show up, listen and deliver for folks in her district.
But while Trisha is advocating for you, Lauren Boebert is spending her time making headlines, avoiding her constituents, and voting to gut the programs Coloradans rely on. That's why I'm counting on you to join me in supporting Trisha's campaign to defeat Boebert.
But grassroots campaigns like this one aren't easy. And right now Trisha is counting on our help to raise the $10,000 she needs to build the early infrastructure it takes to win races like this.

**[Well, with all due respect to Mr. Mason Jr, it is"political" and we at Heartland Journal created the Heartland AwardsTM because you made it so.](https://substack.com/redirect/10cfc574-b3ae-4b9f-817e-ec0a95ede407?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* * *
* * *
The ongoing unrest in Minneapolis has dominated national headlines for much of the new year. With anti-ICE rioters always on the alert for federal agents to confront them, leading to fatal shootings.
What has not gotten nearly the same amount of attention has been Florida's efforts to assist the Department of Homeland Security in arresting illegal aliens residing in the state beyond opening Alligator Alcatraz. Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey recently accused President Donald Trump of sending the large deployment of federal agents in an act of political retaliation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3822036e-4a84-4909-979a-f15ed8d3728c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
"I would just ask you, why is the largest-scale immigration enforcement action taking place where we don't even have that many undocumented immigrants?" Why would it not take place in Texas or Florida or Utah, where you do actually have a large number of undocumented immigrants?" Frey stated.
The difference, Governor Ron DeSantis pointed out in an interview with me, is that unlike sanctuary states and cities like Minnesota and Minneapolis, local police cooperation with federal immigration agents is mandatory. This results in DHS not having to send extra agents to the state since local law enforcement is able to support them during operations.
Due to Operation Tidal Wave, which started last year, Florida law enforcement agencies have made over 20,000 arrests and handed over the illegal aliens to DHS for processing.
"[DHS doesn't] have to worry about the resistance. Not only do we want to cooperate at the state level, we've mandated local governments to do it. Not every local government in Florida wants to cooperate...The mayors know if they don't, then I can suspend them and remove them from office," DeSantis explained.
"We have real teeth in our law to ensure that there's compliance with that," he added.
**You can watch DeSantis ' full answer here:**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/ba9b3f87-f483-4524-96cb-9dbb12f5b02f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
While there have been tense moments during operations in states like Florida and Texas, it has not gotten nearly to the same level of chaos in states like Minnesota, Illinois, or California.
When it comes to the DHS-involved shootings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti, most law enforcement experts agree that had the Minneapolis Police Department been allowed to help with crowd control during those incidents, the shootings would have likely never happened.
Instead, MPD and other departments have only recently been allowed to respond to unruly crowds in any meaningful way. Democratic leaders bear most of the blame by not letting local police help the feds with basic practices until it was too late.
It remains to be seen if the street radicals will be less crazy when interacting with federal agents in the Twin Cities now that Border Czar Tom Homan is in charge. My guess is they probably will not.

Peter: Last week, Donald Trump called on Republicans to “nationalize” voting and take control of elections away from the states, a dramatic and unconstitutional step that would undermine our democracy. In response, Governor Kotek joined every Democratic governor in condemning those remarks as an “undemocratic attempt to silence the American people.” **“Voting in free and fair elections is the foundation of our democracy. All Americans deserve to have their voices heard as they exercise their right to vote, without interference from the federal government.”** Governor Kotek proudly joined her fellow governors in standing up for states to run their own elections, reminding voters that “Trump whines about losing a free and fair election, he’s now openly talking about rigging one in the future,” but the bottom line is **“Democratic governors won’t let that happen.”** Free and fair elections are non-negotiable. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Are we screwed?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
It’s been a difficult few months. Someone recently asked me, **"Are we screwed?"**
What is important in moments like these is not to think in binaries. Good/bad, screwed/not screwed.
There is no doubt that things are bad. Some things, really bad. And they may likely get worse.
But that does not preclude the fact that slowly but surely, some good can be growing as other things fall apart. This is not some syrupy sweet silver lining case for optimism. Rather, it is really about a choice all of us will have to make in life, either consciously or unconsciously: **will I be a person who is safe and creates good for others?**
Will I be a person who stands up? Will I be a person who primarily minds my business and serves myself or try to be part of something bigger? Or will I just be a passive, “neutral” observer of it all?
What I sometimes tell my staff is that **the world we are fighting for is already here**. It exists in small spaces, places, and communities. We don’t have to deal with the insurmountable burden of coming up with novel solutions to the world’s problems.
Much of our work is about scaling existing solutions, many created by small, committed groups of people, that others haven’t seen or don’t even know are around the corner. So while we can’t change the world in a day, we _can_ and _do_ have the power to make our own world within our own four walls, or on our own blocks.
We can grow from there with the faith that somewhere out there, everywhere, others are doing the same. **And we will come together.**
That’s why if you’re a parent, how you parent matters. If you’re a neighbor, how you are a neighbor matters. Many of our biggest problems are results of massively scaled up isolation from others. That means many of our solutions can be found in creating community.
Ultimately, we live in this world and in this time. We have no choice but to engage in it while we’re here. Even running away is a form of engagement. So will your engagement hurt or heal? Build or bring down?
There is no neutral choice, so we can at least do our best to make good ones and learn and do better the next day.
You are allowed to be scared. To grieve. To be angry. But you are also allowed to create good, to be soft, and enjoy the small reprieves. Struggle lasts as long as we do.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

| | The highest viewership in Superbowl history watched as a proud Latino-American celebrated so many things that make our country beautiful—music, dancing, sheer joy, and a multicultural heritage on full display at the nation’s largest sporting competition.

image: @beingblackislit
I felt seen and uplifted, and I know many millions of others did too. Millions more from every background celebrated with us. More than one in five residents of Utah’s District 1 in Utah can boast Latino heritage. We are workers, we are students, we are teachers and doctors, we are athletes, we are musicians, we are dancers. We are Americans. While the president and his followers tried to assert the whiteness of America with their own poorly-attended, poorly-rated halftime concert, the rest of us witnessed something truly special. Todos pertenecemos aquí. ¡Juntos somos América!
### -_Eva_

| We’re now a year into the Trump administration, and I know many of you are feeling the pressure in very real ways.

Grocery bills are higher. Electricity costs keep climbing. Housing feels further out of reach for too many families. And instead of focusing on lowering costs or supporting working people, Trump and his allies have doubled down on chaos and unchecked executive power.

While families are tightening their belts, this administration is dismantling guardrails that protect our democracy and using executive authority to sidestep accountability. At the same time, House Republicans have failed to advance any meaningful legislation to lower costs.

**That’s not acceptable. And it’s not what West Michigan deserves.**

The only real check on Trump’s unchecked power is a Democratic House majority. That’s why November matters so much.

Flipping the House is how we restore balance, protect our democracy, and refocus Congress on delivering results for people, not powerful interests.

Millions of Americans are seeing their premiums spike, coverage vanish, and options disappear. People who counted on the Affordable Care Act to keep their families healthy are suddenly forced to choose between paying for medicine or putting food on the table.

clean_body: Tell Congress: Make healthcare affordable NOW Peter, Healthcare is getting more expensive. Millions of Americans are seeing their premiums spike, coverage vanish, and options disappear. People who counted on the Affordable Care Act to keep their families healthy are suddenly forced to choose between paying for medicine or putting food on the table. This isn't just infuriating—it's heartbreaking. Instead of helping, Republicans in Congress are rolling back the very policies that made healthcare affordable. They let the enhanced ACA premium tax credits expire and cut millions from Medicaid. Yet when asked what solution they will bring forward to help their constituents, they spit out the same old talking points about how the ACA is terrible, not good policy, and needs to be gone. name: Eric H. Holder, Jr.
subject: They’re trying to resegregate America
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
The stakes for American democracy couldn’t be higher, but we are ready to fight for it.
|
---

Peter,
This Black History Month, we find ourselves in a moment that demands clarity and fearlessness.
The forces reshaping our country are testing not only our institutions, but our collective and individual capacity to defend the ideals of this nation. Their actions require from all of us — _all of us_ — a clarity of purpose that is equal to the rising stakes.
**There is a concerted effort to resegregate America.** We are seeing a sustained effort to eradicate the Voting Rights Act, the crown jewel of the civil rights movement. We are witnessing the weaponization of the Department of Justice by the president and his lackeys to silence his critics and to intimidate voters. We are observing frightening, law breaking tactics by federal immigration law enforcement in Minnesota, which has led to the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti.
And behind the scenes, we are experiencing an unprecedented crisis of mid-decade gerrymandering, attempts designed to disproportionately disenfranchise Black and brown voters as the president - acting like an insecure dictator - and those around him desperately cling to power. In states like Texas, Missouri and North Carolina, they are making every effort to silence the voices of communities of color and take away their right to fair representation. But let me be clear: EVERY American will be negatively impacted by what they are trying to do.
As dark as things may seem now, we must remember that every generation has been similarly tested. And each time, Americans have had to ask themselves a critical question: _Do we sit back and hope that help comes along, or do we stand together and fight for what we believe in? _
[**I know what my answer is — and I’m confident I know your answer, too. We are going to fight every day, with everything we’ve got, to defend democracy and the rights of all our people. clean_body: As long as 12 states have sanctuary policies, they will keep coming. | Fellow American, I had the privilege to speak alongside President Trump in the Oval Office, and this question came up... "Would you negotiate with the Democrats over ICE deporting illegal aliens?" The only logical answer is that the Left is made up of complete, radical nut jobs. They want to blame Stephen Miller, Kristi Noem. They want to blame me, and they definitely want to blame President Trump. But the root of the problem is sanctuary cities. As long as 12 states have sanctuary policies, illegal aliens will keep coming. I will not stop working to help President Trump secure our borders and make our cities safer. That means ending sanctuary cities across the country. Our brave men and women in law enforcement hate sanctuary city policies - there's tremendous fraud around them, and it's encouraging more people to come here illegally. Bottom line, it is the policies Chuck Schumer and Democrats are trying to push. We saw how the immigration crisis grew under President Joe Biden. The President supports eliminating sanctuary cities. Let's deliver my bill to make sanctuary cities illegal across America and end the chaos for good. You're either with Chuck Schumer or you're with President Trump and me. The choice is clear. body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2077%2E791427%2ErmLj2H)
Friend, despite the constant racist attacks from the far-right and the ongoing Constitutional crisis that is Trump’s presidency, our campaign is full-steam ahead.
So, we’re reaching out today with one question: [**Will you personally endorse Ilhan Omar as she fights to win reelection and grow our movement for the better world that we know is possible?**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-feb26-personal-endorse/?source=em260209-1-f&akid=2077%2E791427%2ErmLj2H)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-feb26-personal-endorse/?source=em260209-1-f&akid=2077%2E791427%2ErmLj2H)**
It’s no secret that we are in unprecedented times in America.
The second election of Donald Trump in 2024 reflected the anger at real problems that regular Americans face — chief among them being our unaffordable economy and the ever-rising cost of basic essentials, from healthcare to groceries to rent.
But what we have seen from Trump 2.0 has not been a focus on the economy. Instead, Trump and his allies have undergone a massive transformation of the federal government in his image, sliding America into fascism and making life worse for all of us.
Under Trump we have seen power abused time and time again; budgets for essential programs slashed illegally, millions kicked off their healthcare, ICE agents acting as a secret police and brutalizing Americans, pedophiles like Epstein protected, ultra-wealthy scammers and fraudsters pardoned, Trump’s DOJ lackeys launching political prosecutions and investigations, and much much more.
And in the meantime, prices have continued to rise and the average working class American continues to fall behind while billionaires like Trump, Elon Musk, and Jeff Bezos enjoy lower taxes and more wealth than humanity has ever seen.
**Our only way forward is to propose a bold but common sense alternative: A working-class agenda that centers affordability, decency, and justice for all.** A vision of the future where every American gets the healthcare, housing, education, good-paying job, and safe neighborhood they deserve.
Ilhan Omar has fought for that agenda since she first came to Congress in 2019, and has never backed down from taking the right stance on the issues that matter, like supporting Medicare-for-All or fighting to end the Gaza genocide.
But nobody, not Ilhan or anyone else, can do this alone. Change comes from thousands, or even millions, of people coming together in a mass movement and demanding change from the ground up. And for Ilhan, change requires overcoming the immense power of Trump, the far-right, billionaires, AIPAC, corporate interests, and the entire establishment.
That’s why we are asking you to join our campaign today by endorsing Ilhan and standing with her for the fights ahead.
[**Use this link to add your name and say that you PERSONALLY endorse Ilhan Omar for Congress. Ilhan fights for us, and it’s up to us to have her back whenever we can.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-feb26-personal-endorse/?source=em260209-1-f&akid=2077%2E791427%2ErmLj2H)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-feb26-personal-endorse/?source=em260209-1-f&akid=2077%2E791427%2ErmLj2H)**
In solidarity,
Team Ilhan

**Something big just happened in New Jersey, and Washington is paying attention.**
AIPAC poured $2 million into a Democratic primary to try to knock out Analilia Mejia, the only candidate in the Democratic primary for New Jersey’s 11th District who condemned the genocide of Palestinians in Gaza.
**_And it backfired._**
Voters rejected AIPAC’s interference and instead lifted up a candidate who has been outspoken about Palestinian human rights. It’s clear that AIPAC has just failed their attempt to buy a race.

[**Can you chip in to support our race for Congress in CA-34? It’s going to take all of us to fight back against AIPAC’s millions.**](https://act.angela4congress.com/go/128?c0=em_ms_agt_20260209_1.V66FHz&amount=5&refcode=em20260209-335&t=4&akid=335%2E66908%2EnoRH1C)

What happened in New Jersey proves something we’ve been saying all along. When voters show up. When grassroots donors step up. When campaigns are powered by people instead of PACs.
[**If you’re able, chip in today to help us keep building a people-powered campaign that answers only to you!**](https://act.angela4congress.com/go/128?c0=em_ms_agt_20260209_1.V66FHz&amount=10&refcode=em20260209-335&t=5&akid=335%2E66908%2EnoRH1C)

With gratitude and determination,
Team Angela

_**by Cliff Schecter**_
#### **Trump Isn 't the Disease -- He's the Delivery System**
Donald Trump isn't a lone wolf. He's a front man. Behind him--and all around him-- is a classless, venal, vicious crop of billionaire predators who feast on jobs, pensions, and democracy--and this week, they all seemed to pop their domes out of their holes at the same time.
For years, we've been sold a comforting fairy tale: that America's worst predators come in different species. There are _those_ predators; sex traffickers, monsters, villains in Netflix documentaries and then there are _these_ predators; the respectable ones in fleece vests who "optimize" companies, "disrupt" democracy, and somehow always end up with your pension money in their carry-on.
Beside rolled-up tinfoil sporting someone else's cocaine. _I mean,_ _c 'mon, they they totally have no idea how it got there_!
This week blew the lie straight to hell that those with bloodlust for bankrupting their neighbors and our country are different people than the ones who prey on young girls. The only difference is we've allowed the first to become respectable since the Reagan days (remember when they were called "corporate raiders?" Private equity sounds so much more studious. Kinder).
It turns, out destroying people's lives and livelihoods with no allegiance to anything but your own wealth and power is _always evil_. So it turns out, it's the same guys. Same billionaires. Same vibes. Same moral black hole--just different crimes on different days.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.21FXqP0rGnnBxKxt8f8yeUhgtxItlvDuCtX5g9_LYqw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=187434876)
* * *
#### **Meet the Real Super-Predators**
Not street criminals. Not migrants. Not protesters. The real predators wear bespoke suits, run private equity funds, and treat American workers as something they'd wipe off their Prada brushed leather lace-up shoes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6fb2467d-e242-4a2b-98d9-f3551a240860?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Let's begin with the man who somehow became a social connector for some of the most powerful creeps on Earth: **Jeffrey Epstein**. The newly resurfaced photo of **Mark Zuckerberg --**risking it**** all without his protective pigeon poop on his nose**--** dining with Epstein isn't about canceling Zuck for a bad RSVP from years ago. It's about reminding people that Epstein wasn't some fringe oddball lurking on the margins--he was a _network node_. A guy who moved easily among the same elites who now control your information diet, your job security, and your democracy.
Epstein didn't crash these parties. He _was_ the party. And nobody accidentally keeps ending up at the same parties unless the guest list tells you something ugly and true. Melinda Gates has had just a few things to say about that very topic--and her ex-husband--lately.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6fb2467d-e242-4a2b-98d9-f3551a240860?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then there's **Elon Musk** , the world's richest chub-bot, internet reply guy. This week alone we've got Musk's Paris office reportedly raided over Grok's propensity for "creating sexualized images of women and children." Ahh, Grok, his "free speech" AI that mostly seems designed to mainline disinformation directly into our eyeballs when not calling itself "MechaHitler" and thinking up strategies for a 1000-Year Reich that might make it beyond year 12 this time.
_And_ then there were the Epstein files showing Musk essentially begging to get onto Epstein's island. Seriously, the human form of Apartheid granted its wish to be a real boy proves that "edgelord genius" might just be another way of saying "noxious monopoly man with whom pedophiles don't even want to share oxygen."
And once you start pulling the thread, the sweater comes apart fast. **Howard Lutnick** --Wall Street big shot, Trump megadonor, and part of of Trump's "Epstein cabinet" as Senator Jon Ossoff recently put it--bought his house from Epstein's trust. Right next door to Epstein. "Six to eight "steps away" in fact, according to Lutnick in a video dripping with slime that has him discussing massages with his wife at Epstein's place.
Because nothing says "totally normal billionaire real estate transaction" like wiring money to the estate of a convicted sex trafficker.
Meanwhile **Peter Thiel** shows up on taped conversations between Epstein and **Ehud Barak** , who is alleged to have horrifically beaten and taken advantage of young girls he procured via Epstein. As for Thiel, the sweaty, truculent oligarch openly contemptuous of democracy can be found in the Epstein files in a 2014 email from Epstein stating, "that was fun, see you in 3 weeks." And another in 2018 suggesting "Dec visit me Caribbean."
That would be Epstein Island. Did he visit him? Who knows. Did he get together with Epstein? I dunno, what does "that was fun, see you in 3 weeks" mean to you? This is all to remind us, lest we forget, that this isn't just a handful of creeps--it's a transnational boys' club where money, power, and absolute moral rot share the same Slack channel.
Part of the same cabal of capricious, rapacious rot is Jeff Bezos, who found $75MM in his sofa (when JD Vance wasn't lying face down on it) for a Melania Trump documentary nobody asked for, nobody wanted, and nobody saw. Directed by Epstein-files star, Brett Ratner.
Bezos spent $50MM on his second wedding, annoying the entirety of Italy so he and his wife and all the body parts they didn't begin their lives with could tie the knot. But he couldn't find the cash to keep _The Washington Post_ --of Watergate and The Pentagon Papers--flush, so he just destroyed one of the our most historic and once-important newspapers by firing one-third of its staff. All to kiss Trump's ass, which he's had his tongue inserted in since election day, and seemingly has it jabbed so far up he can tell you what Trump had for breakfast.
