* * *
#### **They Prey on Jobs, Pensions, and Democracy**
Here's the part Democrats should tattoo on their foreheads so they don't screw this up: These are _superpredators_ , in every sense of the word. These are the people who hollow out companies, loot pensions, buy influence, crush unions, and then fund politicians who promise to blame someone else.
If they're not preying on young girls, they're preying on our economy, my house, your right to control your body. Maybe all of the above. Because they are the same gross, gilded, gauche, grouping of human pestilence that's been with us since the dawn of time.
The private equity guys who gut companies and torch pensions. The monopoly men who jack up prices, crush competition, and then buy off regulators. The billionaires who prey on your benefits, your wages, your future--_and_ on young girls--_because when you believe rules are for other people, you stop distinguishing between crimes_.
People become inputs. Bodies become commodities. Democracy becomes an inconvenience. Monopolies will fund ICE. Billionaires will sponsor child rape.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6fb2467d-e242-4a2b-98d9-f3551a240860?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And floating above all of this like a weepy, sweaty, Truth-Social-diarrhea-spewing carnival barker is **Donald Trump** --the frontman for **America 's Superpredators**. Trump didn't just know Epstein; he shows up in The Epstein Files more times than he does in his own books he didn't write. He's connected himself to young girls with his pageants where he peaked in on them changing, if you don't wanna believe the Epstein files claims.
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=187434876&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg3NDM0ODc2LCJpYXQiOjE3NzA2NzgzNjYsImV4cCI6MTc3MzI3MDM2NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.3_r1m_WfzSActbRH2mXpc7zE-ih3P8dOg0ldSt_U2qM&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
* * *
#### **Why They Love Trump**
Trump breaks norms so they don't have to. He attacks regulators, courts, journalists, and civil servants. He clears the field for exactly the kind of extraction these parasites have perfected for decades. Trump built a political movement that _serves_ men like him. And them.
Yet, Trump is the mascot. These guys are the owners.
They control information, attack democracy, wreck your financial well-being, and then scream about "freedom" while picking your pockets and shredding the Constitution with Elon Musk's ketamine-fueled chainsaw. Or Zuckerberg's disinformation algorithm that creates unique realities. Like the one where Zuck isn't still a little Harvard incel worshipping women who wouldn't be caught dead with this gangly, gangrenous chud.
It's Monopoly, but the rules are rigged and the board is on fire. And it is attacking our democracy on behalf of Trump through disinformation, undermining elections, pushing Trump to invade Greenland and start a war with _our allies_ so they have space for their AI data-centers, which I'm sure will be used for the public good.
They are pure evil. The slime from Ghostbusters that gains strength from anger. They should be regulated and taxed into oblivion. Taken on directly like we're seeing in Spain, France, and other actual, ya know, democracies. Or they'll end our democracy and an economy that even allows mere millionaires to afford things like childcare, college for their kids, a decent life.
They're like vampires. And it's like a Blade comic. We're fighting a hidden, decadent, and parasitic criminal underworld that manipulates society. Corporate corruption on an unbelievable scale, with untouchable, mostly right-wing elites at the helm. A degenerate subculture operating in modern techno-vulture-capitalism.
Now would be a good time to stop them, before it's too late.

* * *
#### **Oh, Democratic Leadershippp ...**
This is the easiest message of all time if our Democratic leaders don't step on a rake, which, sadly, is at best a 50-50 proposition (and I'm being _super_ kind):
**Here it goes: The same villains. The same system. The same victims**. The Epstein files aren't gossip--they're a roadmap. Follow the money. Follow the power. Call these guys what they are: Superpredators in tailored suits who think they're untouchable.
Then do the one thing they fear more than exposure, and the ones thing that can save our democracy--_take their fucking power away_.

Trump's Jeffrey Epstein Entourage prey on young girls, jobs, pensions, democracy, and now the truth itself--and these billionaire enablers are only getting worse, believe it or not. | | and | Feb 9 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Blue Amp Media is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support our work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. by Cliff Schecter Trump Isn 't the Disease -- He's the Delivery System Donald Trump isn't a lone wolf. He's a front man. Behind him--and all around him-- is a classless, venal, vicious crop of billionaire predators who feast on jobs, pensions, and democracy--and this week, they all seemed to pop their domes out of their holes at the same time. For years, we've been sold a comforting fairy tale: that America's worst predators come in different species. There are those predators; sex traffickers, monsters, villains in Netflix documentaries and then there are these predators; the respectable ones in fleece vests who "optimize" companies, "disrupt" democracy, and somehow always end up with your pension money in their carry-on. Beside rolled-up tinfoil sporting someone else's cocaine. I mean, c 'mon, they they totally have no idea how it got there! This week blew the lie straight to hell that those with bloodlust for bankrupting their neighbors and our country are different people than the ones who prey on young girls. The only difference is we've allowed the first to become respectable since the Reagan days (remember when they were called "corporate raiders?" Private equity sounds so much more studious. Kinder). It turns, out destroying people's lives and livelihoods with no allegiance to anything but your own wealth and power is always evil. So it turns out, it's the same guys. Same billionaires. Same vibes. Same moral black hole--just different crimes on different days. Meet the Real Super-Predators Not street criminals. Not migrants. Not protesters. The real predators wear bespoke suits, run private equity funds, and treat American workers as something they'd wipe off their Prada brushed leather lace-up shoes. | | ---|---|--- Let's begin with the man who somehow became a social connector for some of the most powerful creeps on Earth: Jeffrey Epstein. The newly resurfaced photo of Mark Zuckerberg --risking it** all without his protective pigeon poop on his nose-- dining with Epstein isn't about canceling Zuck for a bad RSVP from years ago. It's about reminding people that Epstein wasn't some fringe oddball lurking on the margins--he was a network node. A guy who moved easily among the same elites who now control your information diet, your job security, and your democracy. Epstein didn't crash these parties. He was the party. And nobody accidentally keeps ending up at the same parties unless the guest list tells you something ugly and true. Melinda Gates has had just a few things to say about that very topic--and her ex-husband--lately. | | ---|---|--- Then there's Elon Musk , the world's richest chub-bot, internet reply guy. This week alone we've got Musk's Paris office reportedly raided over Grok's propensity for "creating sexualized images of women and children." Ahh, Grok, his "free speech" AI that mostly seems designed to mainline disinformation directly into our eyeballs when not calling itself "MechaHitler" and thinking up strategies for a 1000-Year Reich that might make it beyond year 12 this time. And then there were the Epstein files showing Musk essentially begging to get onto Epstein's island. Seriously, the human form of Apartheid granted its wish to be a real boy proves that "edgelord genius" might just be another way of saying "noxious monopoly man with whom pedophiles don't even want to share oxygen." And once you start pulling the thread, the sweater comes apart fast. Howard Lutnick --Wall Street big shot, Trump megadonor, and part of of Trump's "Epstein cabinet" as Senator Jon Ossoff recently put it--bought his house from Epstein's trust. Right next door to Epstein. "Six to eight "steps away" in fact, according to Lutnick in a video dripping with slime that has him discussing massages with his wife at Epstein's place. Because nothing says "totally normal billionaire real estate transaction" like wiring money to the estate of a convicted sex trafficker. Meanwhile Peter Thiel shows up on taped conversations between Epstein and Ehud Barak , who is alleged to have horrifically beaten and taken advantage of young girls he procured via Epstein. As for Thiel, the sweaty, truculent oligarch openly contemptuous of democracy can be found in the Epstein files in a 2014 email from Epstein stating, "that was fun, see you in 3 weeks." And another in 2018 suggesting "Dec visit me Caribbean." That would be Epstein Island. Did he visit him? Who knows. Did he get together with Epstein? I dunno, what does "that was fun, see you in 3 weeks" mean to you? This is all to remind us, lest we forget, that this isn't just a handful of creeps--it's a transnational boys' club where money, power, and absolute moral rot share the same Slack channel. Part of the same cabal of capricious, rapacious rot is Jeff Bezos, who found $75MM in his sofa (when JD Vance wasn't lying face down on it) for a Melania Trump documentary nobody asked for, nobody wanted, and nobody saw. Directed by Epstein-files star, Brett Ratner. Bezos spent $50MM on his second wedding, annoying the entirety of Italy so he and his wife and all the body parts they didn't begin their lives with could tie the knot. But he couldn't find the cash to keep The Washington Post --of Watergate and The Pentagon Papers--flush, so he just destroyed one of the our most historic and once-important newspapers by firing one-third of its staff. All to kiss Trump's ass, which he's had his tongue inserted in since election day, and seemingly has it jabbed so far up he can tell you what Trump had for breakfast. They Prey on Jobs, Pensions, and Democracy Here's the part Democrats should tattoo on their foreheads so they don't screw this up: These are superpredators , in every sense of the word. These are the people who hollow out companies, loot pensions, buy influence, crush unions, and then fund politicians who promise to blame someone else. If they're not preying on young girls, they're preying on our economy, my house, your right to control your body. Maybe all of the above. Because they are the same gross, gilded, gauche, grouping of human pestilence that's been with us since the dawn of time. The private equity guys who gut companies and torch pensions. The monopoly men who jack up prices, crush competition, and then buy off regulators. The billionaires who prey on your benefits, your wages, your future--and on young girls--because when you believe rules are for other people, you stop distinguishing between crimes. People become inputs. Bodies become commodities. Democracy becomes an inconvenience. Monopolies will fund ICE. Billionaires will sponsor child rape. | | ---|---|--- And floating above all of this like a weepy, sweaty, Truth-Social-diarrhea-spewing carnival barker is Donald Trump --the frontman for America 's Superpredators. Trump didn't just know Epstein; he shows up in The Epstein Files more times than he does in his own books he didn't write. He's connected himself to young girls with his pageants where he peaked in on them changing, if you don't wanna believe the Epstein files claims. Why They Love Trump Trump breaks norms so they don't have to. He attacks regulators, courts, journalists, and civil servants. He clears the field for exactly the kind of extraction these parasites have perfected for decades. Trump built a political movement that serves men like him. And them. Yet, Trump is the mascot. These guys are the owners. They control information, attack democracy, wreck your financial well-being, and then scream about "freedom" while picking your pockets and shredding the Constitution with Elon Musk's ketamine-fueled chainsaw. Or Zuckerberg's disinformation algorithm that creates unique realities. Like the one where Zuck isn't still a little Harvard incel worshipping women who wouldn't be caught dead with this gangly, gangrenous chud. It's Monopoly, but the rules are rigged and the board is on fire. And it is attacking our democracy on behalf of Trump through disinformation, undermining elections, pushing Trump to invade Greenland and start a war with our allies so they have space for their AI data-centers, which I'm sure will be used for the public good. They are pure evil. The slime from Ghostbusters that gains strength from anger. They should be regulated and taxed into oblivion. Taken on directly like we're seeing in Spain, France, and other actual, ya know, democracies. Or they'll end our democracy and an economy that even allows mere millionaires to afford things like childcare, college for their kids, a decent life. They're like vampires. And it's like a Blade comic. We're fighting a hidden, decadent, and parasitic criminal underworld that manipulates society. Corporate corruption on an unbelievable scale, with untouchable, mostly right-wing elites at the helm. A degenerate subculture operating in modern techno-vulture-capitalism. Now would be a good time to stop them, before it's too late. Oh, Democratic Leadershippp ... This is the easiest message of all time if our Democratic leaders don't step on a rake, which, sadly, is at best a 50-50 proposition (and I'm being super kind): Here it goes: The same villains. The same system. The same victims. The Epstein files aren't gossip--they're a roadmap. Follow the money. Follow the power. Call these guys what they are: Superpredators in tailored suits who think they're untouchable. Then do the one thing they fear more than exposure, and the ones thing that can save our democracy--take their fucking power away. I’ve been doing this a long time. I’ve seen this movie before. name: Deb Haaland
subject: I rock my ribbon skirt to honor my ancestors
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=7409%2E400544%2ESEaK-_)
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk364-fr-nd&t=2&akid=7409%2E400544%2ESEaK-_)
Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. Did you hear the exciting news? **I have filed to be on the ballot to become New Mexico's next governor!**

I felt so honored to deliver ballot petitions signed by thousands of grassroots supporters across New Mexico. And I felt proud to wear my traditional ribbon skirt as I filed. When I wear traditional clothing — like my ribbon skirt or my mocs — I'm reminded of how powerful our clothing is to our shared heritage. **I rock my ribbon skirt to honor the people whose shoulders I stand on.**

In a minute, I'm going to share some of the other places I've **rocked my ribbon skirt and mocs.** [ _**But before I do, I have to ask:**_**_Will you please help us build on this winning momentum by giving $5 to my campaign right now?_**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5042?refcode=jtk364-fr-nd&t=3&akid=7409%2E400544%2ESEaK-_)
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk364-fr-nd&t=4&akid=7409%2E400544%2ESEaK-_)
---
| | On the day I was sworn in as Secretary of the Interior, I decided to wear my white moccasins and a handmade ribbon skirt adorned with butterflies, stars, and corn. No matter where I go, I am a proud Pueblo woman first — including at the Department of the Interior.
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk364-fr-nd&t=5&akid=7409%2E400544%2ESEaK-_)
---
| | On the first day of the White House Tribal Nations Summit in 2021, I wore my beaded moccasins in solidarity with our Indigenous people across the country. I am incredibly grateful that together, our administration made extraordinary accomplishments for Indian Country — enduring progress that would make our ancestors proud.
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk364-fr-nd&t=6&akid=7409%2E400544%2ESEaK-_)
---
| | From my ancestral homelands here in New Mexico to the halls of Congress — and as I just filed my candidate petition to add my name to New Mexico's ballot for governor — I rock my ribbon skirt to honor my ancestors.
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk364-fr-nd&t=7&akid=7409%2E400544%2ESEaK-_)
---
Friend, history has shown us there’s nothing we can’t accomplish when we work together, which is why I’m counting on the support of people like you as we fight for a New Mexico that works for everyone.
I am so excited and thankful to everyone who helped me pass the first major hurdle in what will be an expensive and competitive race — but this race is just heating up, and we still have a long way to go till November.**I am ready to fight for an education that gives every child the chance to dream big and reach their full potential here in New Mexico. Give families a raise by increasing the minimum wage and the child tax credit. Protect affordable healthcare and expand access to treatment and recovery programs for those suffering from addiction.
**
**_[Please, friend: Will you chip in $5 right now so we can build a strong campaign capable of winning this race and making history again?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5042?refcode=jtk364-fr-nd&t=8&akid=7409%2E400544%2ESEaK-_)_**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk364-fr-nd&t=9&akid=7409%2E400544%2ESEaK-_)
---
I am so grateful for your support. Thank you for being by my side.

Be fierce,
Deb

Kentucky families are feeling the squeeze right now.

From rising grocery bills to unaffordable housing costs to inaccessible healthcare, too many people are working hard and still struggling to get ahead — _especially in rural communities that have been hit hardest by federal decisions that leave them behind._

That's why Gov. Andy Beshear is staying focused on the issues that actually matter. In his State of the Commonwealth speech, he rolled out his top budget priorities for the coming year. His first order of business: fighting for universal pre-K — **because it works**. When kids get a strong start, parents can stay in the workforce, businesses have reliable employees, and our economy grows stronger for everyone. It's one of the smartest investments we can make, not just for our children's future, but for Kentucky's future.

Next, Andy is tackling the rising cost of living head-on. He's prioritizing investments in affordable housing, supporting rural hospitals, lowering healthcare costs, and making sure families can afford to put food on the table. These aren't partisan priorities, Peter, _they're Kentucky priorities._

Andy believes in an American Dream that's real, where no matter where you live, you have a fair shot to build a good life. That's what leaders do; they focus on the work in front of them, bring people together, and fight for solutions that help everyone, **because that's the job they signed up to do.**

| | Donald Trump has turned ICE and CBP into his personal gestapo. His federal agents are murdering American citizens in broad daylight, snatching people off the street into unmarked vans, and terrorizing our communities. This isn't immigration enforcement, it's intimidation. But there's another under-the-radar issue at play here that has me extremely concerned:**the Trump administration is weaponizing private data to track and target American citizens.** As the Senate's resident privacy hawk, I've been warning for years about the dangers of the federal government having unfettered access to Americans' private information, and now, we're seeing exactly how dangerous that is. Here's how I'm fighting back: **1\. ICE is using Palantir apps to collect biometric data on protestors.** This means that Trump's federal agents can track where you go, what you do, and who you talk to. I have a bill to stop them by blocking the feds from getting access to that information. **2\. ICE is purchasing private location and other data from sleazy data brokers through a legal loophole.** Right now, if the U.S. government wants to obtain your location data from a wireless carrier, it has to get a warrant to do so. But there's a little-known legal loophole that allows them to get around that. The federal government can buy up your private information, including your location data, from sleazy data brokers that hoover up your personal info from apps on your phone. I have a bill to close that loophole and put a stop to the government's endrunning of the Fourth Amendment and buying up everyone's data without a warrant. **3\. ICE is using government data from state DMVs and federal agencies and is refusing to answer questions about how that data is used.** As soon as Trump's ICE started grabbing people from the streets, I directed my staff to investigate ICE's domestic surveillance tools and ways to cut them off. My investigation showed that ICE has access to data at the Department of Motor Vehicles in the majority of states, with nearly no guardrails in place. So I immediately pressed governors to cut off ICE's access to DMV data, and I will continue watchdogging this issue. **Privacy is a life-and-death issue.** I've worked for years to sound the alarm on the dangers of the federal government having unrestricted access to Americans' most private data. Unfortunately, we're witnessing the dangers of what happens without any guardrails to protect against mass government surveillance of American citizens. I'll continue using every tool at my disposal to protect every American's constitutional right to privacy. This isn't immigration enforcement, it's intimidation. But there's another under-the-radar issue at play here that has me extremely concerned:the Trump administration is weaponizing private data to track and target American citizens. As the Senate's resident privacy hawk, I've been warning for years about the dangers of the federal government having unfettered access to Americans' private information, and now, we're seeing exactly how dangerous that is. Here's how I'm fighting back: 1\. ICE is using Palantir apps to collect biometric data on protestors. This means that Trump's federal agents can track where you go, what you do, and who you talk to. I have a bill to stop them by blocking the feds from getting access to that information. 2\. ICE is purchasing private location and other data from sleazy data brokers through a legal loophole. Right now, if the U.S. government wants to obtain your location data from a wireless carrier, it has to get a warrant to do so. But there's a little-known legal loophole that allows them to get around that. The federal government can buy up your private information, including your location data, from sleazy data brokers that hoover up your personal info from apps on your phone. I have a bill to close that loophole and put a stop to the government's endrunning of the Fourth Amendment and buying up everyone's data without a warrant. 3\. ICE is using government data from state DMVs and federal agencies and is refusing to answer questions about how that data is used. As soon as Trump's ICE started grabbing people from the streets, I directed my staff to investigate ICE's domestic surveillance tools and ways to cut them off. My investigation showed that ICE has access to data at the Department of Motor Vehicles in the majority of states, with nearly no guardrails in place. So I immediately pressed governors to cut off ICE's access to DMV data, and I will continue watchdogging this issue. Privacy is a life-and-death issue. I've worked for years to sound the alarm on the dangers of the federal government having unrestricted access to Americans' most private data. Unfortunately, we're witnessing the dangers of what happens without any guardrails to protect against mass government surveillance of American citizens. I'll continue using every tool at my disposal to protect every American's constitutional right to privacy. # _Happy Black History Month!_

---
|
---
| | Happy Black History Month! With attacks to DEI and attempts to cancel BHM we’re extra excited to uplift the achievements, leadership, resilience, and brilliance of Black Americans, past and present.
Black history isn’t just something we remember. It’s something we protect, defend, and build upon every single day.
Of course, we are starting with the very roots of Black History Month itself. In 1915, Dr. Carter G. Woodson founded the Association for the Study of African American Life and History (ASALH) to ensure that the stories, contributions, and struggles of Black Americans would never be erased or ignored. At a time when schools and institutions deliberately excluded Black history, ASALH created a movement of education, truth, and empowerment that still shapes our world today.
More than a century later, ASALH reminds us that storytelling is power — and that preserving history is an act of resistance.
---
| |
# _Tracking ICE: Children Should Never be Caged_
---
|
---
| | In 2025 alone, ICE booked nearly 3,800 minors into immigrant family detention centers — facilities that function more like prisons than places of care.
Children have been locked away for weeks and months at a time, many without adequate food. Some without consistent access to water or medical care. And in countless cases, families are inhumanely being separated.
This isn’t about safety. It’s about power.
When a government cages children, strips families of dignity, and treats human lives as disposable, it is a moral failure — full stop.
We will not look away. We will not normalize this cruelty. And we will not stop fighting until every child is free, every family is protected, and humanity is restored to our immigration system.
---
|
---
|
---
| | We had BIG news out of Texas last week when Democrat Taylor Rehmet flipped a Republican state Senate seat in a district Trump won by 17 points.
Let that sink in. In a Fort Worth-area district long considered safely red, voters showed that when working people organize, show up, and demand better, **change is possible anywhere.** Taylor, a labor union leader and veteran, won by more than 14 points in a special election, sending shockwaves through Republican leadership across the country.
Instead of picking a Trump-endorsed Republican candidate, the people of Texas District 9 chose progress over extremism.
“This win goes to everyday working people,” Taylor said — and he’s right.
Progressive candidates can win, even in places the political establishment writes off. Every race matters. Every vote matters. And when we invest in people-powered movements, we build the future we deserve.
---

| | Movement for Freedom is proud to launch our newest initiative: **the Prioritize Humanity Pledge.**
We’ve always been about uplifting leaders who fight for civil rights and human dignity. Now, we’re raising the bar — asking candidates and voters alike to publicly commit to leadership rooted in justice, compassion, and accountability.Prioritizing humanity isn’t radical. It’s the baseline.
If you believe people should always come before politics, power, and profit, add your name to the pledge and help us build a future where dignity leads every decision.
Together, we can demand better — and elect leaders who deliver it.
👉 [Take the pledge](http://movement4freedom.com/humanitypledge)

# CNN anchor spreads Bad Bunny ICE hoax invented by liberal activist
CNN anchor Jim Sciutto amplified a false claim on social media that the boy Bad Bunny gifted a Grammy to during his Super Bowl halftime show **[was a five-year-old recently detained by ICE agents, sparking backlash](https://substack.com/redirect/d33fb759-8280-43de-9f45-e53cf23c30a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after X's Community Note debunked it as misinformation; the child was actually a California actor, with no political link to immigration enforcement.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2b2e06b4-7611-4116-b44b-fc3dac72fd60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Sciutto shares unverified post:** Jim Sciutto reposted activist Ed Krassenstein's claim tying the halftime show's child to ICE-detained Liam Conejo Ramos, framing it as a dig at Trump's policies before deleting it amid corrections.
* **Community Note exposes falsehood:** X users and a Community Note quickly clarified the boy was child actor Lincoln Fox from California, with Bad Bunny's gesture intended to inspire kids rather than make a political statement.
* **Ties into broader halftime controversy:** The rumor fueled criticism of Bad Bunny's performance for celebrating Latin culture and prior anti-ICE comments at the Grammys, highlighting media eagerness to link entertainment to immigration debates.

* * *
# **U.S. forces hunt down and board defiant sanctioned tanker**
U.S. military forces tracked and boarded the Aquila II, a sanctioned crude oil tanker carrying 700,000 barrels of Venezuelan heavy crude, in the Indian Ocean on February 9, 2026, **[after it evaded President Trump's quarantine blockade](https://substack.com/redirect/eb455cd6-ebac-4b3d-813b-460d76195189?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the Caribbean and fled thousands of miles toward China.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eb455cd6-ebac-4b3d-813b-460d76195189?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Global Pursuit Spans Oceans:** The Department of War relentlessly tracked the Aquila II from the Caribbean across multiple ocean basins over weeks, culminating in a helicopter rappelling boarding by U.S. troops without incident as part of enforcing sanctions on Venezuelan oil exports.
* **Trump Quarantine Defiance Highlighted":** The tanker defied President Trump's December 2025-established quarantine on sanctioned vessels leaving Venezuela following Nicolas Maduro's capture, underscoring U.S. determination to block illicit oil flows to markets like China.
* **Enforcement Signals Broader Power:** Officials declared no vessel can outrun U.S. forces, with the operation denying illicit actors access to global maritime domains and following multiple prior seizures of shadow fleet tankers linked to sanctioned Venezuelan crude.

* * *
# RFK Jr declares ultra-processed foods spiritual warfare
Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. branded **[the fight against ultraprocessed foods](https://substack.com/redirect/596c7be2-a9ec-43f6-a552-5bbbcf06a432?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "spiritual warfare" and an "assault on children" during a Heritage Foundation event Monday, marking one year of his Make America Healthy Again agenda. He condemned the foods as worse than cigarettes, driving metabolic diseases and claiming 70% of kids' diets consist of them.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/596c7be2-a9ec-43f6-a552-5bbbcf06a432?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Ultraprocessed assault escalates:** Ultra-processed foods wage war on cellular activity, fueling obesity, diabetes, and costing taxpayers 40 cents per dollar on diet-related chronic diseases, Kennedy warned.
* **New guidelines shift focus:** Updated Dietary Guidelines prioritize protein, healthy fats, and vegetables while cutting grains and processed carbs in federal programs like school lunches and food stamps, without banning choices.
* **Skepticism urged for parents:** Kennedy highlighted rising autoimmune and neurological issues in kids compared to his childhood, calling for fierce skepticism toward corporations and government that commoditize people through harmful products.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

| | Peter,
---
| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

I’ll never lose sight of what millions of families need when I’m Governor, because I’ve experienced those needs too.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=40827%2E3422442%2EPbXhQ1)
Peter,
I lost my mini-van’s keys while grabbing a last-minute ingredient from the grocery store to cook my kids’ dinner—and I had to walk all the way home.
**Being a single mom means navigating all the stresses of life:** stretching a grocery budget, meal planning, car maintenance, and yes, even dealing with things like lost keys.
It’s not the end of the world for me, but it is a reminder that when we talk about which candidate will actually lower costs for Californians, it comes down to who is living our cost crisis and the stress Californians are feeling firsthand.
**I’ll never lose sight of what millions of families need when I’m Governor, because I experience those needs too.**
Here’s the truth: my billionaire opponent _will never understand_ what life is like for the rest of us in California.
When push comes to shove, he can't really relate to the struggles that normal people go through on a daily basis.
**I'm running for governor because California deserves a leader who will put our families first, not billionaires and special interests.**
But we have to raise serious money online if we’re going to win this race. Our billionaire opponent has already poured $38 million into his campaign, and a Republican opponent was the leading fundraiser in the second half of last year.

There was a time when the church shaped the culture. In far too many places, the culture dictates the church. Across America, sanctuaries are packed, stages are polished, and production quality rivals professional entertainment. But beneath the lights and sound systems, something sacred has been traded away. **Biblical authority has been replaced with cultural approval. Conviction has been swapped for comfort.**

# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9519%2E5257348%2EnaKjqe)
Hi Derek,
It’s Senator Adam Schiff, and today I’m excited to make a major endorsement: I’m supporting my friend Eric Swalwell for Governor of California.
[**Before I go on, can I ask you to split a donation to Eric’s campaign and my own right now?**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-swalwell26.x9ZEJg&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20260209_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=9519%2E5257348%2EnaKjqe)
I’m proud to endorse Eric because he has the vision and strength to take our state’s biggest challenges and make real progress, from lowering costs for families to protecting our democracy from Donald Trump.
Congressman Swalwell and I worked together to investigate Trump during his first presidency, and Eric played a leadership role in the impeachment trial after the President incited a violent mob to attack the Capitol on January 6th.
**What I saw then, and what I know now, is that Eric is fully prepared to get things done and deliver for California, even as he will fight to protect our values, rights and freedoms.**
So I made my decision:
[**I’ll be voting for Eric Swalwell for Governor — and I hope you’ll join me by splitting a contribution to his campaign and my own today.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-swalwell26.x9ZEJg&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20260209_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=9519%2E5257348%2EnaKjqe)

2028 is approaching.
**But the election that will determine whether our Republic reaches 2028 intact is in 2026.**
_Read that again._
I’m serious: These midterm elections will be the most consequential in modern history.
And my U.S. Senate reelection in Georgia will be the most critical and most expensive contest of all.
**I am the ONLY Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024.**
If you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight for our Republic’s future — don’t wait until 2028.
Instead, rush $5 to my reelection campaign in Georgia today.
**Here’s the link to donate:**[**https://act.electjon.com/go/Donate**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260209-1-f&t=1&akid=1606%2E5691347%2EuMk4iY)
Consider the damage Trump has done in just one year:
* Infecting our government with cronyism and corruption at unprecedented scale.

* Stacking key agencies with loyalists — and directing them to target, investigate, intimidate, and prosecute critics and opponents.

* Waging an unprecedented campaign of fear, intimidation, and vengeance.

* Handing out million-dollar tax breaks to the wealthiest Americans, while canceling programs that help working families.

* Gutting Medicaid and rural health care, leaving millions unsure how — or where — they’ll get care next year.

* Illegally deploying federal troops on the streets of American cities.

* Threatening to undermine free and fair elections.

Only by regaining Congressional power can we reverse this.
The only real solution is victory.
This is something you can do right now to fight back and make a difference: [**Make a contribution to my reelection campaign today, of $5 or any amount that works for you.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260209-1-f&t=2&akid=1606%2E5691347%2EuMk4iY)
The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more.
[**All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260209-1-f&t=3&akid=1606%2E5691347%2EuMk4iY)

With gratitude,
Sen. Jon Ossoff

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2602-q1-ak [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2602-q1-ak]Folks — Donald Trump said that he wants to drive up housing prices. If you find that hard to believe, read his own comment [https://www.housingwire.com/articles/president-trump-says-he-wants-to-keep-home-prices-high-lower-borrowing-costs/] he made during a Cabinet meeting:
“Existing housing, people that own their homes, we’re gonna keep them wealthy... I don't want to drive housing prices down. I want to drive housing prices up for people who own homes.”
That’s outrageous when young families across Southern and Western Colorado are already locked out of homeownership.
While rents and mortgages continue to rise, first-time homebuyers are getting priced out and cannot secure mortgages. Workers can’t afford to live where they work and spend hours a day commuting. Young people are even struggling to rent in neighborhoods they’ve lived in for their whole lives.
We need leadership in Washington that lowers costs, expands supply, and makes housing affordable again.
Unlike Trump and Hurd, I’m not running to protect the interests of the wealthy few; I’m running to represent every Coloradan. Can you pitch in today? → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2602-q1-ak?]
